etymology.historical_story: English face reached Middle English through French and ultimately traces to Latin facies, referring to form or appearance. Its meanings expanded from the visible front of the head to outward appearance, dignity, and confronting something. In a Malay sentence, an unchanged face should therefore be interpreted through its English meaning and the surrounding context. [Merriam-Webster: face](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/face)

etymology.historical_story: Formal belongs to an international vocabulary associated with established forms and conventions. Its English counterpart traces to Latin formalis, related to forma, meaning shape or form. In Malay, the word connects ceremonial clothing, institutional learning, and regulated communication. These uses share a useful cultural image: an activity takes a recognized shape that participants are expected to follow. [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/formal)

etymology.historical_story: Fire enters this entry as an English word encountered in Malaysia’s multilingual environment. Its meaning changes with the setting: safety signage concerns burning, a game may involve shooting, and workplace talk may concern dismissal. Informal Malaysian mixed speech also uses it for a harsh scolding. These contexts explain why a single Malay translation would be misleading.

etymology.historical_story: Freeza represents the Japanese character name フリーザ, also rendered Frieza in English releases. Its name plays on freezer, fitting the cold-related naming associated with the character. For Malay readers, the important distinction is between a borrowed fictional name and an ordinary appliance word: recognizing the joke does not make Freeza a Malay term for a freezer. [Name-history reference](https://www.kanzenshuu.com/wiki/Frieza)

etymology.historical_story: An early Malay-English vocabulary identifies faham as an Arabic borrowing and records meanings connected with understanding and knowledge. Malay then uses its own morphology to build related forms, including fahamkan. The result illustrates how a borrowed base becomes productive within Malay grammar: its historical source is foreign, while its suffix and sentence patterns belong to Malay. See [Malay-English Vocabulary](https://ms.wikisource.org/wiki/Malay-English_Vocabulary/F).

etymology.historical_story: Fikir belongs to Malay's Arabic-derived vocabulary of thought, associated with Arabic fikr. An early English–Malay vocabulary already records both fikir and fikir-an. Malay morphology supplies -an to form fikiran, while the attached pronoun -mu identifies the listener as possessor. The resulting word combines a borrowed lexical base with Malay grammatical resources. [早期英马词汇表](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/b9/Vocabulary_of_the_English_and_Malay_languages_%28IA_afu7962.0002.001.umich.edu%29.pdf)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: fikir 是思考，fikiran 是心思，-mu 是你的：fikiranmu＝你的心思。

etymology.historical_story: Felipe is a Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese form of Philip. The name ultimately traces to Greek Philippos, combining elements for love and horse. Ancient bearers included Philip II of Macedon, Alexander the Great’s father. This inherited meaning explains the name’s history; it does not describe the personality or interests of someone called Felipe. [Felipe](https://www.behindthename.com/name/felipe), [Oxford LGPN](https://www.lgpn.ox.ac.uk/article/philip)

etymology.historical_story: English foot descends from Old English fōt and belongs to an inherited Germanic word family. Related forms occur in several European languages. The familiar body-part word also names a length unit. This is English lexical history; it does not establish that the spelling foot has become a standard Malay headword. [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/foot)

morphology.pattern_note: -lah 是附着于前词的强调语气小品词，不是派生后缀；此处 suffix 表示其后接位置。词根读音不变。输入的 Jawi فهم 仅记录 faham，未包含 -lah；空缺音节已按完整词形补分。[DBP：小品词的书写](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kau+lah)

senses.zh_definition: 明白；理解。附加 -lah，强调已经理解或终于领会。

senses.nuances: 核心意义来自 faham；-lah 本身不表示完成时态。已经明白或终于明白的解读取决于 dah、sekarang 和上下文。单独回答 Fahamlah 有时显得不耐烦。[DBP：faham](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132444&keyword=faham)

senses.zh_definition: 请理解；体谅一下。用于要求对方领会某事或考虑自己的处境。

senses.ms_definition: Permintaan atau gesaan supaya seseorang mengerti sesuatu atau mengambil kira keadaan orang lain.
senses.nuances: 这是 faham 在祈使句中的用法，不是另一个词根义。柔和语调可表达恳求，强硬语调则可能像责备；更明确的礼貌请求可用 Tolong fahami keadaan saya。[DBP：-lah 的强调作用](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menegaskan)

etymology.historical_story: Fahamlah illustrates how Malay builds conversational meaning around an established word. Faham supplies understanding; the attached particle -lah supplies emphasis. DBP treats this particle as a grammatical element rather than a creator of new vocabulary. The same combination therefore bridges reflective written narration and everyday appeals, with context determining whether the speaker sounds enlightened, reassuring, or impatient. [DBP: particles and derivation](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penegasan+kata)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 faham＝懂，再添 lah＝强调语气：fahamlah 就像“懂了啦”或“理解一下啦”；具体意思听语境。

etymology.historical_story: Feri is borrowed from English ferry, with its spelling adapted to Malay conventions. The familiar two-syllable shape preserves a close connection to the English word. Its meaning centres on carrying people or vehicles across water, making it a useful term in Malaysia's river, strait and island transport vocabulary. The borrowing date is not established here. [词源资料：feri](https://kaikki.org/dictionary/Malay/meaning/f/fe/feri.html)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 英语 ferry 换成马来语拼写 feri，仍是“载人过水的渡轮”；fe 要读清楚 /fe/。

senses.zh_definition: 找到；发现，通过寻找或偶然遇见而确定人或物的所在。
senses.en_definition: To locate or discover someone or something, by searching or by chance.
senses.ms_definition: Menjumpai atau menemukan seseorang atau sesuatu, sama ada melalui pencarian atau secara kebetulan.

senses.zh_definition: 设法获得、找到或安排所需的资源、机会或人选。

senses.zh_definition: 经观察、调查、计算或亲身体验而发现、查明或认为。

senses.ms_definition: Mendapati atau mengetahui sesuatu melalui pemerhatian, penyelidikan, pengiraan atau pengalaman.
senses.nuances: find that 引出发现的事实；find something useful 表示体验后的评价；find out 通常表示查明或得知。参见 [American Heritage find](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=find)。

senses.zh_definition: 察觉自己处于某处、某种处境或正在做某事。
senses.en_definition: To become aware of being in a particular place, situation, or activity.
senses.ms_definition: Menyedari bahawa diri berada dalam keadaan atau situasi tertentu.
senses.nuances: 限 find oneself 结构；不应逐字译为寻找自己。涉及人生方向的 find oneself 则可指认识自我。

senses.zh_definition: 经审议作出裁断或认定，尤其用于司法语境。
senses.en_definition: To reach and declare a formal judgment or decision.
senses.ms_definition: Membuat keputusan atau penentuan rasmi setelah meneliti sesuatu perkara.
senses.nuances: 这是英语 find 的专门义；马来语一般按结构用 mendapati 或 memutuskan。

etymology.historical_story: Find continues Old English findan through Middle English finden. Its modern uses connect locating an object with discovering information, reaching an opinion, and making a formal judgment. English also uses the same form as a noun for a valuable discovery. Malay distributes these meanings across several words rather than one universal equivalent. [American Heritage etymology](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=find).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手电筒 /faɪnd/ 一照：正在找是 cari，终于找到是 jumpa，调查后发现是 dapati。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies firman as a borrowing from Persian. Its Persian source, farmān, denotes a command or decree, a word associated with authoritative pronouncements. In modern Malay, the familiar expression firman Allah places that authority in a sacred setting. Remembering this connection helps explain why the noun carries a solemn register and why ordinary workplace instructions call for different vocabulary. [DBP: Persian origin of firman](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=firman); [Encyclopaedia Iranica: farmān](https://www.iranicaonline.org/articles/farman/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 firman 与固定搭配 firman Allah 一起记：听到 firman，就想到庄重的“神之圣言”。

senses.zh_definition: 好玩的、有趣的、让人觉得开心的。

senses.ms_definition: Menyeronokkan atau menghiburkan; digunakan sebagai sisipan bahasa Inggeris dalam percakapan tidak rasmi.
senses.nuances: 这里记录英语词在马来语句子中的非正式用法，如 memang fun。标准马来语通常使用 menyeronokkan 或 seronok。此释义是编辑性归纳，不是所给资料中不存在的 DBP 马来语词头定义。参见 [DBP：seronok](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=Seronok)。

senses.zh_definition: 乐趣、娱乐或玩乐；常见于会话中直接嵌入的英语短语。
senses.en_definition: Enjoyment, amusement or recreation.
senses.ms_definition: Keseronokan atau hiburan; dalam pertuturan bercampur bahasa, turut muncul dalam ungkapan Inggeris seperti 'just for fun'.
senses.nuances: 所列搭配是可嵌入马来语会话的英语短语，并非马来语固有搭配。just for fun 可换成 sekadar suka-suka，have fun 可换成 berseronok。DBP 的检索结果将 fun 列在英马词典栏目；不能据此认定它是正式马来语词头。参见 [DBP：fun](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=fun)。

etymology.historical_story: In this entry, fun comes directly from English and retains its recognizable spelling. It can sit inside a Malay sentence as a compact expression of enjoyment, while standard Malay offers seronok, menyeronokkan and keseronokan. DBP records its meanings in an English–Malay dictionary, a distinction that helps separate a useful conversational insertion from an established formal Malay headword.

morphology.formula: 马来语语码转换：∅ + forever → forever；英语内部构成：for + ever → forever
morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留为未加马来语词缀的整词；is_root 不表示它在英语内部不可分析。音标采用英式英语读音。英语 for 是独立词，不是马来语前缀。

word_family.gloss: 永远；英语中带文学色彩的扩展形式，非马来语派生词

senses.zh_definition: 永远；永久地；持续到没有尽头的未来。
senses.en_definition: For all future time; without end.
senses.ms_definition: Selama-lamanya; untuk sepanjang masa tanpa berakhir.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词。模板中的 official 仅为所要求的输出标记，不构成 DBP 对其马来语词汇身份的认证。马来语释义为编写的对译，并非 DBP 原文。以下搭配为混合语码示例，不宣称是已核实的高频标准马来语搭配。英语词义参见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/forever)。

senses.zh_definition: 老是；不断地；反复发生，常带不耐烦或埋怨。
senses.en_definition: Continually or repeatedly, often annoyingly.
senses.ms_definition: Asyik atau sentiasa melakukan sesuatu secara berulang-ulang.
senses.nuances: 英语中的反复义通常表达说话者的态度，并非字面上的永恒。混合语码中的对应表达依使用者而异；标准马来语通常用 asyik 或 sentiasa。词义参见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/forever)。

senses.zh_definition: 很久很久地；长得仿佛没有尽头，属于夸张说法。
senses.en_definition: For an extremely long or seemingly endless time.
senses.ms_definition: Untuk tempoh yang terasa sangat lama, sebagai ungkapan berlebih-lebihan.
senses.nuances: 常用于等待、持续说话或耗时过程；不表示真的没有终点。以下搭配为解释性的混合语码示例。英语此义参见 [Collins English Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/forever)。

senses.zh_definition: 漫长得仿佛没有尽头的一段时间。
senses.en_definition: An apparently endless period of time.
senses.ms_definition: Tempoh masa yang terasa amat panjang atau seolah-olah tiada penghujung.
senses.nuances: 英语非正式名词用法，典型结构为 take forever。不得据此认定 forever 已成为标准马来语名词。此分类参见 [Collins English Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/forever)。

etymology.historical_story: English forever developed from the phrase for ever, recorded in the late fourteenth century; writing it as one word became common from the late seventeenth century. Its separate English history matters here: encountering it inside a Malay conversation does not establish Malay derivation. Such examples can instead illustrate speakers moving between languages. [Source: Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/forever).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: for + ever：把时间线一直向未来延伸，记住 forever＝永远；抱怨时也可夸张成“久得没完”。

morphology.pattern_note: 在现代马来语中按完整借词处理，不把 -al 当作本土后缀。依据 DBP 的 fé.de.ral，首个 e 读 /e/，第二个 e 读 /ə/。

senses.zh_definition: 联邦的；由若干州或成员政治单位联合组成，或具有联邦体制性质的。
senses.en_definition: Federal; relating to a federation or a political system in which constituent states form a union.
senses.ms_definition: Bersifat persekutuan atau terbentuk daripada negeri-negeri yang bersekutu.
senses.nuances: DBP 收录此词并标注 IB，即 Indonesia Belanda。马来西亚行政语境通常采用 persekutuan，如 Kerajaan Persekutuan；federal 常见于政治制度讨论或保留英文的名称中。kaum federal 的“联邦主义者”含义由整个短语表达，不宜据此把 federal 单独另列为人物名词。[DBP：federal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=federal)；[DBP：来源缩写说明](https://jendeladbp.my/app/uploads/woocommerce_uploads/2025/08/PB-9-2025-TERBIT-7yzukl.pdf)

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 提及机构时沿用其正式名称。讨论联邦与州的关系时，区分制度名称和具体政府层级，避免把 federal 一概理解为“中央政府”。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 属于中性的政治与制度术语，本身没有尊卑色彩。正式马来西亚公文中，采用既有的 persekutuan 表述通常更自然。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 提及机构时沿用其正式名称。讨论联邦与州的关系时，区分制度名称和具体政府层级，避免把 federal 一概理解为“中央政府”。

etymology.historical_story: Federal belongs to an international vocabulary whose deeper history leads to Latin foedus, a treaty or alliance. That older image of joining by agreement helps explain its political meaning. DBP labels the Malay entry IB, identifying an Indonesian–Dutch connection; this label should not be replaced with an unsupported claim of direct borrowing from English. [Etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/federal) [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=federal)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 federal，就联想 federation：几个州联合成一个联邦；马来西亚常用对应词是 persekutuan。

senses.zh_definition: 闪点：在规定试验条件下，液体释放的蒸气遇到外部点火源能够发生瞬间闪燃的最低温度。

etymology.historical_story: English flashpoint joins flash, suggesting a sudden flare, with point, marking a threshold. The physical meaning concerns vapour briefly igniting when exposed to an ignition source. Figurative uses transfer that image to tensions that can erupt, whether at a critical stage, around a disputed issue, or in a dangerous location. Malay translations preserve these distinctions rather than using one equivalent everywhere. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=kilat+I+1+)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: flash 是突然一闪，point 是临界点：液体遇火一闪是“闪点”，紧张关系快要爆发则是“冲突临界点”。

etymology.historical_story: Behind firaun lies an ancient change in meaning: the Egyptian expression for the great house originally referred to the royal palace, then came to designate its ruler. The palace thus stood for royal authority. Malay received the familiar form through Arabic firʿawn, while the older Egyptian image survives behind the title. [Egyptian background](https://www.globalegyptianmuseum.org/glossary.aspx?id=294), [Arabic borrowing](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/firaun).

Fullers cleaned and finished woollen cloth, using absorbent earth to remove grease and impurities. Malay tanah fuller retains that occupational element inside a material name. etymology.historical_story: Fiona is associated with Scottish literary naming and is commonly linked to Fionn, a Gaelic name connected with fairness or whiteness. James Macpherson used the form Fióna in Fingal in 1761. This literary background explains the name's cultural associations; its historical meaning is not a separate Malay dictionary sense. [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/fiona)

morphology.formula: ∅ + fisher → fisher（外语形式整体保留；姓氏写作 Fisher）
morphology.pattern_note: 按输入将 fisher 作为未作马来语派生分析的整体保留。英语捕鱼者义可分析为 fish + -er，但 -er 不是此处的马来语词缀，动物义也不能据此直接解释。音标为英语读音。

senses.zh_definition: 费舍尔：英语姓氏；具体中文译名可依本人或既有译例确定。
senses.en_definition: Fisher, a surname with several historical origins, including an occupational name for a fisherman.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga Fisher, yang antara asal sejarahnya ialah gelaran pekerjaan bagi orang yang menangkap ikan.
senses.nuances: 专名首字母写作 Fisher。没有原始语境，不能认定数据包中的 fisher 必然属于姓氏义，也不能将某位当代姓氏持有者理解为渔民。姓氏来源参见 [Ancestry：Fisher](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/fisher)。现有证据不足以将此形式标为官方马来语普通词；本条马来语释义均为解释性编写。

senses.zh_definition: 英语词：捕鱼的人，尤指以捕鱼为业者；渔民。
senses.en_definition: A person who catches fish, especially for a living.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, orang yang menangkap ikan, khususnya sebagai mata pencarian; nelayan.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词义，普通马来语职业表达通常用 nelayan；休闲垂钓者可按语境称 pemancing。词义与英语读音参见 [Cambridge Dictionary：fisher](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/fisher)。以下为马来语中讨论英语术语的表达框架，不是已验证的马来语高频搭配。

senses.zh_definition: 英语动物名：渔貂，学名 Pekania pennanti，原产北美的鼬科食肉哺乳动物。
senses.en_definition: A North American forest-dwelling carnivorous mammal of the weasel family, Pekania pennanti.
senses.ms_definition: Mamalia karnivor keluarga Mustelidae yang berasal dari Amerika Utara, bernama saintifik Pekania pennanti dan dikenali sebagai fisher dalam bahasa Inggeris.
senses.nuances: 这是英语动物俗名，不是捕鱼者的职业称谓，也不指渔猫。物种身份参见 [美国鱼类及野生动物管理局：Fisher](https://www.fws.gov/species/fisher-pekania-pennanti)。以下是动物说明中的自然组合，不标称马来语高频搭配。

senses.zh_definition: 英语皮毛用语：渔貂的毛皮。
senses.en_definition: The fur or pelt of a fisher.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan bahasa Inggeris berkaitan bulu haiwan, bulu atau kulit berbulu daripada haiwan fisher.
senses.nuances: 属于动物名引申出的材料义，需要皮毛或贸易语境才能确定。马来语中宜明说 bulu fisher 或 kulit berbulu fisher。该英语义项见 [Merriam-Webster：fisher](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/fisher)。

etymology.historical_story: Fisher preserves several distinct histories. As an English occupational surname, it can recall an ancestor's work catching fish. The North American animal name has a different association: Maine's wildlife department connects it with fitch or fiche, a name for a European polecat or its pelt. The animal does not typically eat fish. [Maine wildlife department](https://www1.maine.gov/ifw/fish-wildlife/wildlife/species-information/mammals/fisher.html).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到“菲舍”，先看语境：Fisher 大写常是姓氏；英语 fisher 可指捕鱼者；动物语境则是渔貂。

morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语语境中作为外来整词处理，不作马来语词缀拆分。德语规范形式为 Führer；所列 IPA 为德语读音，ü 是圆唇前元音 /yː/。

senses.zh_definition: 元首：在纳粹德国历史语境中指阿道夫·希特勒的领袖称号。
senses.en_definition: The historical title associated with Adolf Hitler as leader of Nazi Germany.
senses.ms_definition: Gelaran kepimpinan Adolf Hitler dalam konteks sejarah Jerman Nazi.
senses.nuances: 这是德语称号在历史叙述中的引用形式，通常写作 Führer，也见 Fuehrer。德语原词另有普通的“领导者、向导”等意义，但不能因此在马来语中把它当作 pemimpin 的日常同义词。本条马来语释义为编辑释义，并非已核实的 DBP 原文；status 按指定输出格式保留，不表示 DBP 已认证此拼写。[Duden：Führer](https://www.duden.de/rechtschreibung/Fuehrer)

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 适用于严肃的历史说明、引用或分析；不要把它当作对上司、教师或朋友的尊称。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 讨论时明确纳粹德国的历史背景。用这个称号给现实人物起绰号，容易被理解为侮辱、独裁指控或对纳粹符号的轻率使用。

etymology.historical_story: German Führer belongs to the family of führen, meaning to lead. Its ordinary German uses include a leader or guide, but its adoption as Hitler's political title gave it a sharply different historical resonance. In Malay historical writing, that title is normally retained as a foreign expression rather than treated as an everyday leadership term. [Duden](https://www.duden.de/rechtschreibung/Fuehrer)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Führer 与历史课上的“元首称号”绑定记忆；日常的“领导者”另记 pemimpin。不要把德语 ü 直接读成普通的 /u/。

morphology.pattern_note: 月份名整词记忆，无马来语词缀变化；e 读 /e/，u 与 a 分属不同音节。规范书写首字母大写。音节划分为补充分析。

senses.nuances: 规范写作 Februari，不能因词库键名为小写而在正文中沿用小写。表示某月通常用 pada bulan Februari；完整日期可写 15 Februari 2027。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=februari)

etymology.historical_story: Februari belongs to the international family of month names descended from Latin Februarius. The Roman name was associated with februa, means or rites of purification. That ancient ritual background survives in the name, although modern Malaysian usage simply identifies a civil-calendar month and carries no expectation of religious observance. [Historical reference](https://www.etymonline.com/word/February)

senses.zh_definition: 【英语】旗；旗帜，用作国家、团体的象征或信号。
senses.en_definition: A flag: a piece of cloth used as an emblem or signal.

etymology.historical_story: English flag connects a visible signal with the practical act of marking something for attention. Email interfaces preserve that familiar image through small flag symbols. A separate English verb means to weaken or tire. These dictionary senses explain possible readings of the token, but they do not establish an official Malay borrowing or its adoption history.

etymology.historical_story: Fotografi belongs to an international vocabulary built from Greek elements associated with light and writing or drawing. The memorable idea is drawing with light: a camera records light to produce an image. Malay uses fotografi for the art, process or occupation, while foto and fotograf name the resulting picture. The distinction helps separate practice from product.

etymology.historical_story: English file in the document sense traces to Medieval Latin filare, referring to threading documents onto a string or wire. That physical arrangement supplies a useful image for an organized collection of records, including digital records today. The tool word has a separate Old English ancestry. Malay uses fail for documents. [Word history](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/file).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 file /faɪl/ 与马来语 fail 成对记：同一个文件概念，正式马来语换成 fail；锉刀义则换成 kikir。

etymology.historical_story: Fight descends from Old English feohtan, rather than from a Malay root. Its English history includes both physical conflict and determined resistance. In a Malay conversation, retaining fight therefore introduces an English lexical item whose interpretation depends on context. Its presence in an English–Malay dictionary does not itself establish it as a standard Malay headword. [Oxford word origin](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/fight_1).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: fight /faɪt/ 可借“发起对抗”的画面记忆；gh 不发音。遇到它先判断：是在打架，还是在争取？

etymology.historical_story: Malay fail corresponds to English file in office and computing vocabulary. Adding the Malay suffix -kan turns the document container into an action: putting something on file. The same verb also covers official submission for registration. This connects two familiar administrative activities, keeping an organized record and formally lodging a document with an institution.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: fail 是“档案”，加 -kan 就是“把它归入档案”；遇到申请或诉状，则想成“正式提交登记”。

etymology.historical_story: Fasih is borrowed from Arabic faṣīḥ, associated with clear, eloquent speech. Its Jawi spelling preserves Arabic letters that distinguish the source sounds. In Malay, the word describes both articulate speaking and fluency in a particular language. Malay also builds its own derivatives, including kefasihan and memfasihkan, around the borrowed base.

morphology.pattern_note: 此处 is_root 表示未加马来语词缀的整词单位。英语内部可分析为 fluff + -y；该分析不属于马来语构词。IPA 采用英语读音，以下词族也均为英语形式。

senses.zh_definition: 绒毛般蓬松柔软的；长着细软绒毛或覆盖着绒屑的。
senses.en_definition: Covered with, resembling, or having the softness of fluff or fine fur.
senses.ms_definition: Berbulu halus atau mempunyai permukaan yang lembut dan gebu; boleh juga berselaput serpihan bulu halus.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词，在马来语交谈中可作语码混用；DBP 英马词典按语境译为 gebu 或 penuh dengan bulu，并不意味着 fluffy 已成为规范马来语词形。以下 ms 搭配为马来语混用表达。[DBP：fluffy 的英马释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=gebu)

senses.zh_definition: 质地轻盈、内部充满空气而松软的，尤指食物。
senses.en_definition: Light, airy, and soft in texture, especially of food.
senses.ms_definition: Bertekstur ringan, berongga udara dan lembut, khususnya makanan seperti kek atau telur dadar.
senses.nuances: 强调轻盈松软，不只是容易咬开；规范马来语通常用 gebu，必要时补充 ringan dan lembut。[Cambridge 英马词典：fluffy](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english-malaysian/fluffy)

senses.zh_definition: 内容轻浅、缺乏实质或不够严肃的。
senses.en_definition: Lightweight, superficial, or lacking substantial content.
senses.ms_definition: Bersifat ringan atau cetek serta kurang isi yang bermakna atau mendalam.
senses.nuances: 这是英语比喻义；在马来语混用中，听者未必熟悉。形容娱乐内容时可仅表示轻松，评价报告或人物能力时通常带贬义。[Merriam-Webster：fluffy](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/fluffy)

etymology.historical_story: English fluffy combines fluff with the adjective-forming suffix -y, and Merriam-Webster dates its earliest known use to around 1825. Its physical meanings connect soft fibres with light, airy textures. Its figurative meaning treats insubstantial writing or entertainment as similarly lacking weight. In Malay contexts, gebu supplies a useful equivalent for many physical uses. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/fluffy), [DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=gebu)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象轻吹一口气，绒毛 fluff 蓬起来：fluffy 就是蓬松柔软；蛋糕里充满小气孔，也可以 fluffy。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为英语词形整体识记，不作马来语词缀分析；所列 IPA 为英语英式读音，不能视为统一的马来西亚口语读音。

etymology.historical_story: This entry concerns an English word appearing inside a Malay context, not a demonstrated Malay lexical borrowing. English expressions such as fast food and fast track can retain their English form in multilingual communication. Their presence in Malay material does not establish an official Malay headword, a Malay affix family, or a standard Jawi spelling.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 借熟悉的 fast food 记住速度义，再配对马来语：动作快用 cepat，行驶快常用 laju。

senses.zh_definition: 组屋、公寓住宅单元；也可依上下文指容纳这些住宅的楼宇，在马来西亚常使人联想到较经济的多层住宅。
senses.en_definition: A self-contained dwelling in a building divided into separate residences; contextually, the residential building itself.
senses.ms_definition: Rumah pangsa, iaitu unit kediaman dalam bangunan yang dibahagikan kepada beberapa unit berasingan.
senses.nuances: 常见于住宅名称、地址和日常交谈；正式说明可用 rumah pangsa。低价住宅是常见联想，不是判断所有 flat 的必要条件。英语 flat 的“平坦、泄气”等意思不能自动列为此马来语名词的义项；音乐术语另写 flet。本释义依据 DBP 咨询说明整理，并非逐字引述词条。[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=flat)

etymology.historical_story: The housing term flat comes from British English. In Malaysia, it sits alongside rumah pangsa and pangsapuri in everyday discussions of urban housing. DBP guidance associates flat particularly with lower-cost residences. That association helps explain local usage, but it should not be treated as a judgment about the people living there. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=rumah+pangsa)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 flat 联想到住宅楼的一层平面：同一层分出几户，每户就是一个 flat；“平面”只是记忆联想。

etymology.historical_story: Freddie belongs to the English tradition of familiar personal names and is commonly used as a short form of Frederick. Its familiar character concerns how a person is addressed; it does not give that person a dictionary meaning in Malay. In Malay sentences, the name retains its identity while surrounding verbs and prepositions follow Malay grammar. [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/freddie)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Freddie 记成两拍 FRED-ee，联想一个叫“弗雷迪”的朋友；人名整体记，不硬拆马来语词根。

senses.zh_definition: 雀类小鸟，通常具有适于啄食、剥开种子的短而粗壮的喙；狭义尤指雀科鸟类，部分其他科的鸟类英文俗名也含 finch。
senses.en_definition: A small songbird, especially one of the family Fringillidae, typically with a short, stout bill adapted for eating seeds; also used in the common names of certain similar birds.
senses.ms_definition: Burung penyanyi kecil, khususnya daripada famili Fringillidae, yang lazimnya berparuh pendek dan tegap untuk memakan biji; nama Inggeris ini juga digunakan bagi beberapa burung seakan-akan itu daripada famili lain.
senses.nuances: 此处按英语鸟名及其在马来语语境中的引用用法解释，不能据此认定为 DBP 已核准的马来语词目。马来语释义为编写释义，并非 DBP 官方原文。不要把所有 finch 都等同于麻雀，亦不要仅凭俗名判断鸟科。英语词义和读音参见 [Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/finch)；喙形及名称范围参见 [American Heritage Dictionary](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=finch)。下列搭配为自然构造示例，未核实语料频率。

etymology.historical_story: Finch continues Old English finc and belongs to a Germanic word family that includes Dutch vink and German Fink. Its long English history explains why related bird names contain the same element. That history does not establish when, or whether, finch became a standardized Malay borrowing. Source: [Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/finch).

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在此是附着于名词的后附代词或回指成分，表示“它的／其”；不改变词根拼写，也不表示复数。数据包的 Jawi فاءيده 仅对应词根 faedah，未包含 -nya；此处按输入保留。音节字段按输入保留 null，实际可分为 fa.e.dah.nya。

etymology.historical_story: Faedah belongs to Malay's Arabic-derived vocabulary and is related to Arabic fāʾidah, meaning benefit or gain. In modern Malay, its meanings encompass both practical usefulness and financial interest. Adding -nya links either meaning to an understood referent, so context determines whether faedahnya concerns an activity's benefits or a sum of money's interest.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 faedah＝益处／利息，再把 -nya 当作回指箭头：faedahnya＝“它的益处／那笔钱的利息”。

morphology.pattern_note: freedom 是英语词；此处按输入将整词作为马来语夹用单位，is_root 不表示英语中不可分析。英语内部可分析为 free + -dom。输入的 sso drpd sst 是“某人／从某事物”的词典缩写，绝非音节，已改为 free.dom；IPA 使用英语读音，Jawi 保留 null。

senses.zh_definition: 自主选择、行动或表达的自由；免受不当强制或限制的状态。
senses.en_definition: The ability or right to act, choose, or express oneself without undue restraint.
senses.ms_definition: Kebebasan untuk bertindak, memilih atau menyatakan pendapat tanpa paksaan atau sekatan yang tidak wajar.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词义，标准马来语通常使用 kebebasan。此条 official 标记保留请求中的记录格式，不表示 freedom 已获认定为标准马来语词。ms_definition 是马来语释义，不是声称存在同形马来语官方词条；本词各义项的 ms 搭配栏保留英语原搭配。参见 [DBP《英马词典》：freedom](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=freedom)。

senses.zh_definition: 摆脱奴役、囚禁或外来统治的自由；政治语境中的独立。
senses.en_definition: Release from captivity, servitude, or foreign rule; political independence.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan bebas daripada tahanan, perhambaan atau pemerintahan asing; kemerdekaan mengikut konteks.
senses.nuances: 人的获释通常用 kebebasan 或 pembebasan 表达；国家摆脱外来统治则常用 kemerdekaan。不可把所有 freedom 都机械译成 kemerdekaan。

senses.zh_definition: 免受痛苦、匮乏、恐惧或其他负担的状态；某些语境中的豁免。
senses.en_definition: The state of being free from an unwanted condition, burden, or obligation.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan bebas daripada sesuatu yang membebankan, menyakitkan atau tidak diingini, atau keadaan mendapat pengecualian daripada sesuatu kewajipan.
senses.nuances: 英语 freedom from 常对应马来语 bebas daripada，而非逐字翻译为一个固定名词短语。涉及税费等义务时，pengecualian 可能比 kebebasan 更准确。

senses.zh_definition: 获准自由使用某处场所、设施或资源的权限。
senses.en_definition: Permission to use or move about a place without the usual restrictions.
senses.ms_definition: Kebenaran untuk menggunakan sesuatu tempat atau kemudahan, atau keluar masuk ke sesuatu tempat, dengan bebas.
senses.nuances: 强调被允许使用或出入，并不表示拥有该场所。此义在英语中成立，马来语应按具体行为译出。

collocations.en: permission to move freely around the grounds

etymology.historical_story: Freedom is inherited from Old English frēodōm, formed from the ancestor of free and the suffix -dom. It therefore predates modern discussions of workplace flexibility or personal lifestyle. In Malay contexts, distinguish the English word from kebebasan and, for national independence, kemerdekaan. Its historical formation is documented by [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/freedom).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: free＝自由的，英语 -dom 表示状态：freedom＝自由这种状态。标准马来语对应 kebebasan。

senses.nuances: 属于英语词在马来语会话中的使用；正式马来语宜按情况写作 tidak memberikan respons、terhenti 或 paparan tidak berubah。以下为混语搭配，不能视为标准马来语搭配。

senses.zh_definition: 【英语夹杂用法】使食物或液体冷冻、结冰；或自行冻结。
senses.en_definition: Become solid through cold, or preserve food by freezing it.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan campur kod, membeku atau membekukan makanan dan cecair.
senses.nuances: 标准马来语按及物性分别使用 membeku 和 membekukan。英语 freeze 在混语中可接马来语宾语，但正式说明应使用相应马来语动词。

senses.zh_definition: 【英语夹杂用法】暂停某项活动，或冻结账户等，使其暂时不能使用。
senses.en_definition: Temporarily suspend an activity or prevent an account or resource from being used.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan campur kod, menghentikan sesuatu kegiatan buat sementara atau menyekat penggunaan sesuatu akaun atau kemudahan.
senses.nuances: 标准马来语常用 membekukan、menggantung 或 menangguhkan，须依据具体对象选择。冻结账户、暂停招聘和固定价格并非完全相同的行为；正式文件应说明实际限制。

etymology.historical_story: English freeze descends from Old English frēosan, a Germanic verb associated with becoming frozen. Its meanings extend from physical solidification to immobility and suspension. That semantic connection helps explain references to unresponsive screens and restricted accounts. In a Malay sentence, the unchanged English spelling signals code-switching; it does not by itself establish official Malay borrowing status.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 /friːz/，想象画面像结冰一样不动：食物是冷冻，屏幕是卡住，账户是冻结。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为独立词素记忆，无可分析的马来语前后缀。以下相关词组通过复合构成，不属于加缀派生。

senses.zh_definition: 电路中的过电流保护装置，电流超过规定值时通过熔断导体切断电路；保险丝，熔断器。
senses.en_definition: An electrical protective device whose fusible element melts to interrupt a circuit when the current exceeds a specified value.
senses.ms_definition: Peranti untuk menyekat arus elektrik yang mengalir melalui sesuatu litar apabila arus melebihi nilai tertentu.
senses.nuances: 日常说 fius putus 表示保险丝熔断。fius 与可复位的 pemutus litar（断路器）属于不同装置，技术说明中应准确区分。[DBP 电学术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=peranti)

senses.zh_definition: 使爆炸装置起爆的机械或电子装置；引信。
senses.en_definition: A mechanical or electronic device that initiates an explosion; a fuze.
senses.ms_definition: Peranti mekanikal atau elektronik untuk mencetuskan sesuatu letupan.
senses.nuances: 用于军事、排爆或相关技术语境。此义不能译成电气保险丝；英语技术文本常以 fuze 区分引信义与电气 fuse。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=fius)

etymology.historical_story: Fius closely matches English fuse in both form and technical meaning. Malay dictionaries preserve two distinct applications: interrupting excessive electrical current and initiating an explosion. These applications create a useful contrast for learners: one device stops an electrical process, while the other starts an explosive event. Context determines the intended meaning. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=fius)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用英语 fuse 联记 fius：家电里是保险丝，爆炸装置里是引信；先看场景，再选中文义。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为马来文中的外来姓氏整词处理，无马来语词缀。历史上的 Fitz- 不是马来语前缀。英语通常读三个音节，重音在第二音节；读音参见 Cambridge。

senses.zh_definition: 菲茨杰拉德：具有盎格鲁—诺曼来源的爱尔兰姓氏，历史含义为“杰拉尔德之子”。
senses.en_definition: An Irish surname of Anglo-Norman origin, historically meaning son of Gerald.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga Ireland yang berasal daripada bahasa Perancis Anglo-Norman dan secara sejarah bermaksud anak Gerald.
senses.nuances: 专有名词，正文通常写作 Fitzgerald；部分持有人采用 FitzGerald，应保留其本人拼写。姓氏本身不能确定是某位作家、歌手或其他人物。马来文释义为编写说明，并非 DBP 引文；官方马来语词条身份未获核实。词源参见 [Oxford 姓氏词典引文](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/fitzgerald)，英语读音参见 [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/pronunciation/english/fitzgerald)。下列为姓名使用组合，非经频率统计的普通词搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Fitzgerald preserves an older way of identifying a person through a father’s name. Anglo-Norman fi(t)z meant son, so the surname identified a son of Gerald. Established in Ireland, the name also acquired the Irish form Mac Gearailt. This historical structure explains its origin without making Fitz- a productive prefix in modern Malay. Source: [Oxford Dictionary of Family Names of Ireland, via Ancestry](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/fitzgerald).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按英语节奏记“fits—JER—əld”；再把姓氏故事连成“Gerald 的儿子”。历史解释只帮助记姓氏，不用于造马来语派生词。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语借词，整词记忆；sy 对应 /ʃ/，末音节的 e 为 /ə/。派生词 memfiksyenkan 中，词首 f 保留。

word_family.gloss: 把真实素材改写成虚构故事

senses.zh_definition: 主要由想象创作而成的文学作品，如小说和短篇故事；虚构文学。
senses.en_definition: Literature created principally from imagination, especially novels and short stories.
senses.ms_definition: Karya sastera yang dicipta daripada imaginasi seperti novel dan cerita pendek; cereka.
senses.nuances: 指文学类别时为中性词，不表示作品具有欺骗性。作品可以借用真实历史或人物，但情节允许虚构；常与 bukan fiksyen（非虚构作品）对举。

senses.zh_definition: 编造出来、并非事实的故事或说法。
senses.en_definition: An invented story or account that is not factual.
senses.ms_definition: Cerita yang diada-adakan.
senses.nuances: 用于评价某人的说法时可能带有否定或质疑意味；不能仅因叙述生动就认定为 fiksyen。表达尚未查证的信息时，belum disahkan（尚未证实）更准确。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 谈论小说或影视故事时语气中性；直接把他人的解释称为 fiksyen，可能被理解为指责对方编造事实。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于文学评论、出版分类和阅读交流。涉及真人真事时，应清楚区分虚构改编、未经证实的说法与已确认的事实。

etymology.historical_story: Fiksyen adapts English fiction to Malay spelling and pronunciation. Its sy represents the sound heard in English sh, while the ending is pronounced with a schwa. Malay also has cereka for imaginative narrative. The two dictionary senses preserve an important cultural distinction: inventing a novel is an accepted creative act, whereas inventing an account presented as fact invites suspicion.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: fiksyen 的读音让人联想到 fiction：翻开小说，进入“想象编成的世界”。这是联想记忆，不是词根拆分。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词，不按马来语词缀拆分；此处采用英式读音，aw 表示 /ɔː/，全词一个音节。名词与表示讨好的动词同形，但词源不同。输入未提供分音节或爪夷文，保留 null。

senses.zh_definition: 幼鹿，尤指尚未断奶的小鹿。
senses.en_definition: A young deer, especially one that is not yet weaned.
senses.ms_definition: Anak rusa, khususnya yang masih menyusu; makna kata bahasa Inggeris fawn.

senses.ms_definition: Berwarna perang muda kekuningan.

seluar berwarna perang muda kekuningan (fawn trousers)

senses.zh_definition: 以过分殷勤、恭维或卑躬屈膝的态度讨好某人。
senses.en_definition: To seek someone's favour through excessive praise or servile attention.
senses.ms_definition: Mengampu atau menunjukkan kemesraan secara berlebih-lebihan untuk mengambil hati seseorang.
senses.nuances: 英语常用 fawn on、fawn upon 或 fawn over，通常带贬义；不是普通的礼貌或真诚赞赏。标准马来语可依语境使用 mengampu 或 mengambil hati。[Collins 释义](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/fawn)。

etymology.historical_story: English fawn hides two separate histories. The young-deer noun came through French from a Latin word for offspring; its colour sense evokes the animal's coat. The flattering verb instead developed from Old English expressions of gladness, later associated with demonstrative affection and servile behaviour. Their matching spelling does not indicate a shared origin. [Etymological source](https://www.etymonline.com/word/fawn).

etymology.historical_story: Ferrari began as an Italian occupational surname connected with metalworking; its history reaches Latin ferrum, meaning iron. [Surname source](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/ferrari). The automotive name comes from Enzo Ferrari. In 1947, the 125 S became the first car to bear his name. [Ferrari history](https://www.ferrari.com/content/dam/ferrari-fcom/old/pdf/cos_ferrari_inizio_celebrazioni_70_anni_eng.pdf). This creates a memorable historical link between an inherited craft surname and a modern marque, without making Ferrari a Malay word for either iron or blacksmith.

etymology.historical_story: English fan has two separate histories. The admirer sense is a shortening of fanatic, while the air-moving device belongs to a different word history. Their identical spelling explains the ambiguity of fan in mixed-language conversation. Neither English history alone establishes official Malay borrowing status. [Merriam-Webster: fan](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/fan).

etymology.historical_story: Fredo appears in Malay-language cultural contexts as a person's name rather than an established everyday vocabulary item. One documented example is the performer associated with Flybaits: MACP lists FREDO and FREDO FLYBAITS as pseudonyms for a writer whose registered name includes Alfredo. This documents a naming connection, but does not establish a Malay lexical etymology or identify the intended person in the supplied packet. [Source: MACP writer register](https://macp.com.my/storage/musiccreatorsdocuments/Writer_Masterlist.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Fearless is an English formation combining fear with the suffix -less, meaning 'without'. Dictionary.com records its Middle English predecessor fereles between 1350 and 1400. Its appearance in a Malay conversation illustrates English–Malay code-switching; that use should be distinguished from treating the word as an established Malay derivative. [Source: Dictionary.com](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/fearless).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听成 fear + less：把 fear“恐惧”拿掉，就是“无畏”。这里 -less 表示“没有”，不只是“比较少”。

etymology.historical_story: Feb is simply a shortened written form of Februari. The month name ultimately belongs to the Latin Februarius tradition, associated with purification rites. An ancient ritual name thus survives in an ordinary Malaysian calendar abbreviation. The link explains the distant history of the month name, rather than identifying a Malay root or affix. [DBP: Feb](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=feb); [February: name and history](https://www.timeanddate.com/calendar/months/february.html).

etymology.historical_story: Farhan comes from Arabic farḥān, meaning happy or joyful. Its Arabic spelling is فرحان, and its consonants belong to the Arabic family associated with joy. etymology.historical_story: Foto belongs to the international vocabulary of photography. The deeper Greek elements behind photography refer to light and writing, giving the memorable image of writing with light. Malay attaches -nya to foto without changing the base. A short expression can therefore identify someone's photograph while leaving ownership, authorship, and the person pictured to be clarified by context. [Princeton University Library](https://dpul.princeton.edu/greek-collections/feature/inside-the-hellenic-collections-photography)

senses.ms_definition: Gelombang kontroversi, kritikan atau kemarahan yang tercetus secara mendadak dan hebat.

etymology.historical_story: English combines fire and storm to name a blaze powerful enough to generate fierce inward winds. The physical image also supports a figurative meaning: criticism arrives with overwhelming force, like flames driven by turbulent air. In Malay contexts, the English expression can appear in quotations or code-switching; its imagery remains English rather than a native Malay derivation.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把英语fire（火）与storm（风暴）连起来：现实中是烈火风暴，舆论中就是批评如风暴般扑来。

etymology.historical_story: The Ferris wheel takes its name from engineer George Washington Gale Ferris, whose giant observation wheel debuted at Chicago's 1893 World's Columbian Exposition. Malay uses the name in roda Ferris, combining its ordinary word for wheel with the inventor's surname. This explains the attraction's name, rather than establishing ferris as an independent Malay common noun. Reference: [MIT Lemelson: George Ferris](https://lemelson.mit.edu/resources/george-ferris).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ferris 当作人名标签：roda 是“轮”，roda Ferris 就是“费里斯轮”，即摩天轮。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 通常标示第三人称领属或回指，表示其功能／职责；不是复数标记。ng 表示 /ŋ/，ny 表示 /ɲ/，加接时词干不变。完整音节为 fung.si.nya。输入 Jawi فوڠسي 对应 fungsi，尚未包含 -nya。

word_family.gloss: 功能性；发挥功能的状态或程度

senses.zh_definition: 它的功能、作用或用途；某个器官、部件、工具或系统所承担的工作。
senses.en_definition: Its function, purpose, or operating role.
senses.ms_definition: Kegunaan atau kerja yang dilakukan oleh sesuatu organ, alat, bahagian atau sistem yang dirujuk.
senses.nuances: -nya 通常回指前文的事物，例如按钮或器官。fungsinya 不表示功能正常；要表达运作正常，可说 berfungsi dengan baik。基础释义参见 [PRPM：fungsi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=fungsi)。

senses.zh_definition: 其职责或职能；某个人、职位、机构或组织所承担的任务与作用。
senses.en_definition: His, her, or its duties, responsibilities, or institutional role.
senses.ms_definition: Tugas atau peranan yang dipikul oleh seseorang, sesuatu jawatan atau sesebuah organisasi yang dirujuk.
senses.nuances: 常见于行政、组织和工作汇报。领属对象可以是人，也可以是机构；中文与英文应按实际对象选择对应代词。参见 [PRPM：fungsi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=fungsi)。

senses.zh_definition: 其函数；与所讨论的数学对象或问题相关、为定义域中每个元素指定唯一输出的对应关系。
senses.en_definition: The function associated with the mathematical object or problem under discussion.
senses.ms_definition: Pemetaan yang dirujuk, yang memadankan setiap unsur domain dengan tepat satu unsur kodomain.
senses.nuances: 数学用语。须由数学上下文确定，不能把日常的功能义一律译作 function 的数学义。-nya 回指已知对象或关系。PRPM 亦收录 fungsi 的数学用法：[PRPM：fungsi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=fungsi)。

senses.zh_definition: 其函数；程序或模块中可被调用、执行特定任务的代码单元。
senses.en_definition: A callable function belonging to the program or module being discussed.
senses.ms_definition: Unit kod yang dirujuk dalam sesuatu atur cara atau modul dan boleh dipanggil untuk melaksanakan tugas tertentu.
senses.nuances: 计算机编程用语。只有上下文确实涉及代码函数时才采用此义；应用程序的 fungsinya 常常仍指一般功能或用途。

etymology.historical_story: Fungsi belongs to an international vocabulary of work and purpose. Malay etymological references trace it to Dutch functie, ultimately connected with Latin functio, meaning performance or execution. Malay then adds its own -nya to express an associated function or role, combining a borrowed technical noun with familiar local grammar. See [Wikikamus: fungsi](https://ms.wiktionary.org/wiki/fungsi).

etymology.historical_story: English friend descends from Old English frēond and belongs to the same Germanic family as German Freund and Dutch vriend. etymology.historical_story: Fuckin represents a colloquial spelling of English fucking, often also written fuckin’. etymology.historical_story: Fail is the Malay borrowing corresponding to English file. Its meanings connect the office folder, the records kept together inside it, and the named electronic unit stored on a computer. Adding the Malay clitic -nya integrates the noun into Malay grammar. The resulting form can identify an owner or simply point back to a file already mentioned.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: fail 像英语 file，-nya 像贴上的“其”字标签：failnya＝其文件；具体是“谁的”或“那个”，看上下文。

word_family.gloss: 未来主义的；具有未来感的

senses.zh_definition: 【英语；可见于马英夹用】未来；今后的生活、发展或前途。
senses.en_definition: Time yet to come, or a person's or thing's prospects for later development.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, masa yang belum tiba atau prospek kehidupan dan perkembangan pada masa akan datang; padanan bahasa Melayunya ialah masa depan atau masa hadapan.
senses.nuances: 本条记录英语形式及其夹用，不据此认定 future 是经 DBP 确认的规范马来语普通词。status 沿用所要求的条目标签，不表示 DBP 认证。以下搭配保留夹用形式；正式马来语应改用 masa depan 或 masa hadapan。ms_definition 是释义说明，并非冒充官方词典原文。[DBP 对应译法](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?d=10&k=sustainable)；[英语发音](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/pronunciation/english/future)

senses.zh_definition: 【英语】未来的；将来的；以后将具有某种身份的。
senses.en_definition: Existing or happening at a later time, or becoming something later.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, berkaitan dengan waktu kemudian atau keadaan yang akan berlaku; padanannya termasuk akan datang dan bakal, mengikut konteks.
senses.nuances: 这是英语形容词义。以下是马英夹用表达，不是建议采用的正式马来语搭配；future husband 应译为 bakal suami，future plans 可译为 rancangan masa hadapan。不要按英语语序机械拼接正式马来语。[DBP 的 future 对应术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=masa+depan)

etymology.historical_story: English future developed through French from Latin futurus, meaning something that is going to be. That origin fits its everyday connection with plans, hopes, and what comes next. When future appears inside a Malay conversation, its presence illustrates language mixing; the ordinary Malay expressions masa depan and masa hadapan already convey the central meaning. [Etymological reference](https://www.etymonline.com/word/future)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作“fyu-cher”，听到它就把时间轴往前推：future → masa hadapan → 未来。不要照拼写逐字读成马来语音节。

senses.en_definition: A rich, soft confection made with sugar, milk or cream, and butter.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis gula-gula lembut dan padat yang dibuat daripada gula, susu atau krim serta mentega, lazimnya dengan bahan perisa.
senses.nuances: 马来语饮食语境可直接保留英语名称。它不必含巧克力，也不等于布朗尼或一般太妃糖。输入没有提供 DBP 释义，此处马来语为编写释义；不据此宣称 DBP 已核定该拼写。[Cambridge Dictionary：fudge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/fudge)

senses.zh_definition: 用于冰淇淋等甜点的浓稠巧克力甜酱，尤其见于英语名称 hot fudge。
senses.en_definition: A thick, sweet chocolate sauce, especially served with ice cream.
senses.ms_definition: Sos coklat manis yang pekat, khususnya sebagai pelengkap aiskrim.
senses.nuances: 这是英语、尤其美国英语中的用法；在马来西亚菜单中遇到时应依产品判断，不能把所有 fudge 都理解为酱。[Cambridge Dictionary：fudge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/fudge)

collocations.zh: 配巧克力浓酱的冰淇淋

senses.zh_definition: 含糊处理或回避明确回答；也指对事实、数字作不诚实的调整。
senses.en_definition: To evade a clear answer or dishonestly alter facts or figures.
senses.ms_definition: Mengelakkan jawapan yang jelas atau mengubah fakta dan angka secara tidak jujur.
senses.nuances: 这是英语动词义，只适用于英语或英马夹杂表达，不应当作已确立的标准马来语动词。以下为夹杂搭配；正式马来语应依语境用 mengelakkan persoalan 或 memanipulasi angka。[Cambridge Dictionary：fudge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/fudge)

senses.zh_definition: 回避明确决定或答案的含糊方案、处理办法或折中安排。
senses.en_definition: An evasive arrangement that avoids a clear decision or answer.
senses.ms_definition: Penyelesaian atau aturan yang mengelakkan keputusan atau jawapan yang jelas.
senses.nuances: 属于英语名词义，常含批评意味；以下夹杂搭配用于辨识英语借用，不是推荐的正式马来语表达。可依语境改述为 penyelesaian yang mengelakkan keputusan jelas。[Cambridge Dictionary：fudge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/fudge)

collocations.zh: 一项含糊回避的政治安排

etymology.historical_story: The confection's English name has an uncertain origin, but its popularity is closely associated with American women's colleges. Vassar records connect Emelyn Battersby Hartridge with an early documented recipe, while noting that she received it from someone else. Students made the sweet in their rooms, helping establish its campus reputation; this does not prove that Vassar invented either the candy or its name. [Vassar: Fudge Mania](https://www.vassar.edu/vq/issues/2013/02/vassar-yesterday/)

senses.zh_definition: 航班；一次乘飞机进行的旅程。此处说明英语词在马来语夹杂英语的交流中的航空义，规范马来语对应词为 penerbangan。
senses.en_definition: An aircraft journey or a scheduled airline service, expressed using an English word within Malay discourse.
senses.ms_definition: Perjalanan dengan kapal terbang atau perkhidmatan penerbangan berjadual; padanan bahasa Melayunya ialah penerbangan.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词，不能仅凭语料排名标为正式马来语词。PRPM 将 flight 收于《Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan》的英语词项，并在航空义下对应 penerbangan。本条不将英语中的楼梯段、逃离等其他义项直接移植为马来语义项。上述马来语释义为编辑性概括。[DBP 英马词典对应项](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=penerbangan)；读音见 [Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/flight_1)。

etymology.historical_story: English flight descends from Old English flyht, a word for flying that predates powered aircraft. Modern aviation gave this older word a familiar travel application: an individual journey by plane. In a Malay entry, its English history must remain distinct from Malay word formation; penerbangan supplies the standard Malay equivalent. [Sources: Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/flight_1), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=penerbangan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 flight /flaɪt/ 与 fly /flaɪ/ 连起来记：fly 是飞，flight 是一趟飞行；正式马来语换成 penerbangan。

senses.zh_definition: 因察觉或预期危险、伤害而产生的害怕或恐惧。
senses.en_definition: An unpleasant emotion caused by perceived or anticipated danger or harm.
senses.ms_definition: Perasaan takut atau ketakutan apabila menghadapi atau menjangkakan bahaya.

senses.zh_definition: 对未来可能发生的不良事情的担心或忧虑。
senses.en_definition: Anxiety or concern that something undesirable may happen.
senses.ms_definition: Kebimbangan terhadap kemungkinan berlakunya sesuatu yang buruk.
senses.nuances: 侧重对结果的担忧，对应 kebimbangan；不必伴随强烈惊恐。英语复数 fears 可表示多项担忧。

senses.zh_definition: 尤指面对上帝或神圣权威时怀有的敬畏。
senses.en_definition: Profound reverence or awe, especially toward God.
senses.ms_definition: Rasa takut yang disertai hormat dan takzim, khususnya terhadap Tuhan.
senses.nuances: 宗教义不能一概译成惊恐。fear of God 的具体内涵取决于信仰传统；英语习语 put the fear of God into someone 则常表示把某人吓得厉害。

senses.zh_definition: 害怕某人、某事，或因害怕而不愿做某事。

senses.ms_definition: Takut akan seseorang atau sesuatu, atau takut untuk melakukan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 英语 fear 是动词；fear snakes 对应 takut akan ular。日常英语中 be afraid of 往往更口语化，马来语交流通常直接使用 takut。

senses.zh_definition: 担心某人遭遇危险，或忧虑不良事情可能发生。
senses.en_definition: To worry about someone's safety or anticipate an undesirable outcome with anxiety.
senses.ms_definition: Bimbang akan keselamatan seseorang atau kemungkinan berlakunya sesuatu yang buruk.
senses.nuances: fear for someone 表示为某人担心；fear someone 通常表示害怕那个人，介词改变关系。

etymology.historical_story: Fear belongs to English, not to the Malay affix system. Its history reaches back to Old English fǣr, associated with sudden danger or peril, and the related verb fǣran, meaning to frighten or take by surprise. The modern emotional meaning therefore belongs to a history involving both external danger and the response it provokes. [Merriam-Webster: fear](https://scrabble.m-w.com/dictionary/fear)

etymology.historical_story: English fair brings together words with different histories. The adjective meaning pleasing, attractive or just descends from Old English fæger. The event noun followed another route, through French from a Latin word associated with holidays. Keeping those histories separate helps explain why a fair price concerns reasonableness, while a book fair is a gathering for displaying and selling books. [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/fair_1); [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/fair)

etymology.historical_story: The name belongs to the same historical naming tradition as Spanish Filipinas. During the Villalobos expedition in 1543, a name honouring Prince Felipe, the future Philip II of Spain, was applied to an island in the Visayas. It subsequently extended to the archipelago. This explains the royal name behind Malay Filipina, without establishing its immediate borrowing route. [Philippine National Commission for Culture and the Arts](https://ncca.gov.ph/about-culture-and-arts/in-focus/philippines-gateway-to-the-orient-from-legazpi-to-malaspina/)

etymology.historical_story: Finnick is documented as a fictional personal name in Suzanne Collins’s Hunger Games series. An interview with Collins identifies Catching Fire as the book in which Finnick and Johanna make their debuts. This establishes a literary context, but does not establish the name’s linguistic derivation or its status as a Malay dictionary word. Its precise etymology remains unverified here. etymology.historical_story: Fisik offers a useful lesson in regional vocabulary: closely related languages need not choose identical forms for the same concept. Indonesia uses fisik for the body and for bodily qualities, while Malaysian terminology commonly uses fizikal or jasmani. DBP explicitly preserves this regional distinction in its terminology tables. These references establish usage, but do not by themselves establish the exact historical borrowing route.

etymology.historical_story: English food descends through Middle English fode from Old English fōda, meaning nourishment. Its presence in a Malay conversation represents the use of an English word, while standard Malay uses makanan. The historical English lineage is documented by the [American Heritage Dictionary](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=food); it should not be mistaken for a Malay root or a Malay affix formation.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 描述自己时通常表示愿意配合。请求别人调整安排，可说 Bolehkah waktunya dibuat lebih fleksibel?，比直接要求对方 Jangan kaku 更得体。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 职场中应说明灵活的具体范围，例如时间、地点或处理方法。称自己 fleksibel 不自动表示任何时间都可配合，也不表示同意放弃原则。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 描述自己时通常表示愿意配合。请求别人调整安排，可说 Bolehkah waktunya dibuat lebih fleksibel?，比直接要求对方 Jangan kaku 更得体。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 职场中应说明灵活的具体范围，例如时间、地点或处理方法。称自己 fleksibel 不自动表示任何时间都可配合，也不表示同意放弃原则。

etymology.historical_story: Fleksibel illustrates the adaptation of English vocabulary into Malay spelling. DBP's terminology guide lists it among borrowings retaining the initial fl consonant cluster. In Malay it functions as a complete adjective, while kefleksibelan uses native noun-forming morphology. The related noun fleksibiliti is also recorded, showing another established form within the same lexical family. See [DBP terminology guide](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/umum_istilah.pdf) and [DBP: fleksibiliti](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=fleksibiliti).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fleksibel 和英语 flexible 联系起来：时间表能调整，处事方式能变通；记住“安排灵活、人也懂变通”。

morphology.pattern_note: 借入后作为完整词根使用；不拆成 fo- 与 -sil。派生时可加 ter- 或 peN-...-an，后者在 f 前采用 pem- 并保留 f。

senses.zh_definition: 化石：保存在地层等介质中的古代生物遗体、遗物或活动痕迹。
senses.en_definition: The preserved remains, impressions or traces of organisms from the geological past.
senses.ms_definition: Tinggalan atau sisa jasad haiwan atau tumbuhan zaman purba yang kini mengeras dan tertanam di dalam bumi, seperti dalam batuan.
senses.nuances: 马来语释义依据输入所引《Kamus Dewan》；中英文采用现代古生物学范围，也包括印痕和活动遗迹。并非所有化石都必须完全石化。bahan api fosil 是固定术语“化石燃料”，不表示煤、石油和天然气都是可辨认的生物化石标本。参见 [DBP：fosil](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=fosil) 与 [美国国家公园管理局](https://home.nps.gov/bibe/learn/nature/fossils.htm)。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 用于科学、教育和博物馆语境时中性。把人叫作 fosil 可能暗讽对方年老或思想落伍，容易冒犯。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 描述标本时可直接使用。fosil hidup“活化石”是形象说法，不代表相关生物完全没有演化；谈论人物时宜采用具体、尊重的描述。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 用于科学、教育和博物馆语境时中性。把人叫作 fosil 可能暗讽对方年老或思想落伍，容易冒犯。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 描述标本时可直接使用。fosil hidup“活化石”是形象说法，不代表相关生物完全没有演化；谈论人物时宜采用具体、尊重的描述。

etymology.historical_story: Fosil belongs to an international scientific vocabulary associated with Latin fossilis, meaning obtained by digging. The image fits discoveries made in rock and sediment, although modern fossils include preserved traces as well as bodies. The available evidence does not establish the immediate language through which this word entered Malay. See the [National Park Service](https://home.nps.gov/bibe/learn/nature/fossils.htm).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fo.sil 与英语 fossil 连起来记：两者都指古代生命留下的化石；马来语只写一个 s。

morphology.pattern_note: 单音节借词，词尾 /ks/ 为辅音群；派生 memfakskan 时，meN- 在 f 前实现为 mem-，保留 f。

senses.zh_definition: 传真件；通过电子扫描并经电话线路等传输的文件、文字或图像。
senses.en_definition: A document or message transmitted electronically by scanning, typically over a telephone line; a fax.
senses.ms_definition: Dokumen atau mesej yang dihantar melalui pengimbasan elektronik menggunakan talian telefon atau saluran seumpamanya.
senses.nuances: 本义依据输入的《Kamus Dewan》释义整理。menghantar faks 指发送传真；mesin faks 才明确指传真机。口语可说 faks 给某人，正式行文宜用 menghantar faks 或 memfakskan。词义来源：[DBP PRPM：faks](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=146196&keyword=faks)。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于行政、商业及文件传递场景。沟通时说明发送的是文件、使用的是传真方式，避免把 faks 与电子邮件附件混为一谈。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 词本身语体中性。向客户或上级提出要求时，可说 Sila hantarkan dokumen tersebut melalui faks，并按关系使用适当称谓。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于行政、商业及文件传递场景。沟通时说明发送的是文件、使用的是传真方式，避免把 faks 与电子邮件附件混为一谈。

etymology.historical_story: DBP also records faks as a shortening of faksimile. This compact form names a document transmitted through electronic scanning. Its integration into Malay is visible in memfakskan: Malay affixes turn the borrowed base into a verb meaning to send by fax. The word therefore illustrates both lexical shortening and productive Malay word formation. [DBP PRPM：faks](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=146196&keyword=faks)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 faks 与英语 fax 对起来：声音相近，都是“传真”；memfakskan 就是“把文件传真过去”。

morphology.formula: ∅ + forget → forget（英语基本形式；马来语对应词为 lupa 等）
morphology.pattern_note: 此处按整词处理，不作马来语词缀分析。英语过去式为 forgot，过去分词通常为 forgotten，分词 forgetting 双写 t。数据包的 various translations 不是音节标注，已更正。

senses.zh_definition: 忘记；无法回想起原先知道的信息、人物或经历。
senses.en_definition: To fail to recall previously known information, a person, or an experience.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak ingat atau tidak dapat mengingati sesuatu atau seseorang; padanan bahasa Melayunya ialah lupa atau terlupa.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词义，马来语释义为对应说明，并非把 forget 认定为正式马来语词。forget doing 指不记得已经发生的行为。[Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/forget)。

senses.zh_definition: 因一时未想起而忘了做应做或打算做的事情。
senses.en_definition: To fail to do something because it does not come to mind at the required time.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak melakukan sesuatu yang sepatutnya dilakukan kerana terlupa.
senses.nuances: 英语 forget to do 表示忘了执行某事；与表示不记得既有经历的 forget doing 有别。以下 ms 提供标准马来语对应搭配。

collocations.en: forget to reply to a message

senses.zh_definition: 忘了携带某物；因疏忽而未把所需物品带在身边。
senses.en_definition: To fail to bring something because one did not remember it.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak membawa sesuatu kerana terlupa; terlupa membawa.
senses.nuances: 自然的标准马来语通常明确说 terlupa membawa。英语要交代物品遗落的地点时，通常使用 leave，如 leave my keys at home。

senses.zh_definition: 不再想着某人或某事；依语境也指搁置、不再考虑某项计划或可能性。
senses.en_definition: To stop thinking about someone or something, or cease considering a possibility.
senses.ms_definition: Melupakan seseorang atau sesuatu, atau tidak lagi mempertimbangkan sesuatu rancangan atau kemungkinan.
senses.nuances: 马来语可依对象使用 melupakan、tidak lagi memikirkan 或 membatalkan。英语 forget about 常见于此义；并非每次都指记忆能力失效。

senses.zh_definition: 用于 forget yourself：因情绪或兴奋而失去应有的自制或礼貌，举止失当。
senses.en_definition: In forget yourself, to lose normal restraint and behave inappropriately.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam ungkapan forget yourself, hilang kawalan diri sehingga bertindak tidak sopan atau tidak wajar.
senses.nuances: 属于固定反身表达，不能按字面理解为忘记自己的身份。此义及 forget it 等习语可参见 [Oxford Learner's Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/forget)。forget it 可表示算了、别在意或拒绝，须结合语气判断。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场培训 / 双语表达说明
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam panduan dwibahasa ini, perkataan Inggeris 'forget' diterjemahkan sebagai 'lupa', 'terlupa' atau 'melupakan' mengikut konteks.

dual_scenarios.en: In this bilingual guide, the English word 'forget' is translated as 'lupa', 'terlupa', or 'melupakan', depending on the context.

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 熟悉双方都懂英语的朋友之间可以混用 forget；正式马来语公文、考试或面向广泛受众的说明宜用 lupa、terlupa 或 melupakan。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 全部 ms 搭配均为马来语对应表达，不表示 forget 已成为正式马来语词。DBP 双语词典亦提供 lupa、terlupa、melupakan 等对应形式，见 [PRPM《Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan》检索结果](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=melupakan)。英语 Forget it 可能显得不耐烦，安慰别人时应结合温和语气。

etymology.historical_story: Forget continues Old English forgietan and belongs to a Germanic family that also includes Dutch vergeten and German vergessen. Its history is English, even when Malaysian speakers insert it into Malay conversation. Such switching reflects multilingual interaction; it does not by itself establish official Malay borrowing status. Standard Malay expresses the relevant meanings with lupa, terlupa, or melupakan.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 forget 和 lupa 配对记；提醒别人时，Don't forget 对应 Jangan lupa。

morphology.formula: ∅ + friends → friends（马来语语料中的英语整词）
morphology.pattern_note: 依输入保留整词词根标记；英语内部实际为 friend + -s，复数词尾在浊辅音 /d/ 后读 /z/。这不是马来语构词规则。

senses.zh_definition: 朋友们；彼此认识、喜爱或保持友好关系的人。英语 friend 的复数形式，可见于马来西亚的语码转换。
senses.en_definition: People whom one knows and likes; the plural of the English noun friend, used in English–Malay code-switching.
senses.ms_definition: Kawan-kawan atau sahabat-sahabat; bentuk jamak kata bahasa Inggeris friend yang digunakan dalam percampuran bahasa.
senses.nuances: 这是英语形式，不能因出现在马来语语料中便视为获 DBP 认可的马来语普通词。正式马来文通常用 kawan-kawan、sahabat 或 rakan-rakan；此处马来文释义为说明性翻译。英语复数及核心义参见 [Oxford：friend](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/friend_1)。

etymology.historical_story: English friends is the plural of friend, which descends from Old English frēond and belongs to a Germanic family associated with loving. Its appearance inside a Malay sentence illustrates switching between English and Malay. The English plural ending remains attached; Malay itself normally expresses the corresponding meaning with words such as kawan or sahabat. [Oxford word origin](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/friend_1).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: friend 是一位朋友，friends 是朋友们；末尾读 /z/，切换成马来语可记 kawan-kawan。

etymology.historical_story: Fa is the Malay name of the Arabic letter ف, also used in Jawi. Its dictionary entry preserves two different kinds of ordering: its place in an alphabet and its traditional numerical value. Keeping these apart reveals a cultural feature of Arabic literacy, in which letters can serve both as written signs and as numbers.

etymology.historical_story: François belongs to a European family of names represented by Latin Franciscus, Italian Francesco and English Francis. The French national library records these corresponding forms for Francis of Assisi, who was originally baptized Giovanni. In Malay writing, the name remains a personal identifier rather than acquiring an ordinary dictionary meaning; Francois may preserve a person's chosen unaccented spelling. [Source: Bibliothèque nationale de France](https://catalogue.bnf.fr/ark%3A/12148/cb11903378b)

senses.zh_definition: 落下；跌倒；从较高位置向较低位置移动。
senses.en_definition: To move downward or suddenly lose an upright position.
senses.ms_definition: Jatuh atau bergerak dari kedudukan yang lebih tinggi ke kedudukan yang lebih rendah; terjatuh apabila hilang keseimbangan.
senses.nuances: 这是英语义项，不是马来语普通词义。马来语按情境译为 jatuh、terjatuh 或 gugur。以下 ms 字段中的英语搭配是供翻译识别的原文，并非马来语搭配。[Cambridge：fall](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/fall?topic=easiness-and-simplicity)

senses.zh_definition: 数值、数量、水平或强度下降。

senses.zh_definition: 进入某种状态，尤指逐渐或非刻意地发生的状态变化。
senses.en_definition: To enter a particular state or condition.
senses.ms_definition: Beralih atau masuk ke dalam sesuatu keadaan, lazimnya tanpa disengajakan.
senses.nuances: 英语义项，须结合补语理解；fall asleep 译为 tertidur，fall ill 可译为 jatuh sakit。不可把 fall 单独替换为固定的马来语词后机械拼接。[Cambridge：fall](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/fall?topic=easiness-and-simplicity)

senses.zh_definition: 跌落或跌倒这一事件。
senses.en_definition: An act or instance of falling, especially an accidental one.
senses.ms_definition: Kejadian seseorang atau sesuatu jatuh, khususnya secara tidak sengaja.
senses.nuances: 英语可数名词；马来语通常以 terjatuh 或其他完整短语表达，无须强求一对一名词对应。[Cambridge：fall](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/fall?topic=easiness-and-simplicity)

senses.zh_definition: 数量、价值或水平的下降。
senses.en_definition: A decrease in an amount, value, or level.
senses.ms_definition: Penurunan atau pengurangan sesuatu jumlah, nilai atau paras.
senses.nuances: 英语名词义项，马来语通常译为 penurunan。与“跌倒事件”义项应分开理解。[Cambridge：fall](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/fall?topic=easiness-and-simplicity)

senses.zh_definition: 政权、城市或强大机构的覆灭、失守或垮台。
senses.en_definition: The defeat, collapse, or loss of power of a state, city, or institution.
senses.ms_definition: Kejatuhan atau keruntuhan sesebuah kerajaan, kota atau institusi.
senses.nuances: 英语引申义；马来语常用 kejatuhan 或 keruntuhan。不能据此把 fall 当作可直接用于马来语公文的词。[Cambridge：fall](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/fall?topic=easiness-and-simplicity)

senses.zh_definition: 秋季；主要为美式英语用法。
senses.en_definition: Autumn; chiefly North American English.
senses.ms_definition: Musim luruh, iaitu musim antara musim panas dengan musim sejuk di kawasan yang mengalami empat musim.
senses.nuances: 英语季节名称；标准马来语为 musim luruh。马来西亚本地季节讨论通常不采用温带四季划分；涉及旅行或海外学期时可使用这一概念。[Cambridge：fall](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/fall?topic=easiness-and-simplicity)

etymology.historical_story: English fall continues Old English feallan through Middle English. Its basic downward-motion meaning supports familiar extensions involving prices, power and changing states. The same spelling also names autumn in North American usage. In Malay translation, these meanings separate into expressions such as jatuh, penurunan, kejatuhan and musim luruh. [Word history: Merriam-Webster](https://scrabble.m-w.com/dictionary/fall); [senses: Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/fall?topic=easiness-and-simplicity)

morphology.pattern_note: 未发现可确认的马来语词缀结构。Fuoshan 在部分交通及商业资料中指向 Foshan（佛山）；不能据此认定它是规范马来语词目。未核实其标准马来语读音或爪夷文。

senses.zh_definition: 部分外文资料中用于指称中国广东省佛山市的地名写法；通常规范写作 Foshan。此处为地名对应关系的推定，并非已核实的马来语普通词。
senses.en_definition: An occasional spelling referring to Foshan, a city in Guangdong, China; not a verified standard Malay headword.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk nama tempat yang digunakan dalam sesetengah sumber untuk merujuk kepada Foshan, sebuah bandar di Guangdong, China; bukan kata umum bahasa Melayu yang telah disahkan.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，正文应大写。根据检索到的用例，最可能对应佛山；缺少原始语境，仍不能排除其他专名。以下搭配使用规范名称 Foshan，不宣称 fuoshan 有高频马来语搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Fuoshan appears in some international travel and commercial records as a spelling associated with Foshan in Guangdong. That documentary occurrence does not establish a separate Malay word or an official Malay spelling. Its useful learning context is the movement of Chinese place names across languages, where unfamiliar romanizations require checking against a reliable geographical reference.

etymology.historical_story: FBL illustrates how specialist abbreviations acquire different meanings in different industries. A Malaysian competition report uses it for Fulfilled by Lazada, while FIATA uses it for its negotiable multimodal transport bill of lading. These are separate naming conventions, not stages in the development of one Malay word. The packet provides no context that selects between them. [MyCC](https://mycc.gov.my/sites/default/files/%5BBook%202%5D%20Draft%20final%20report%20%28E-commerce%20retail%20marketplaces%29.pdf), [FIATA](https://fiata.org/n/fbl-webinar-icc-guidance-key-regulatory-developments-and-fiata-events-updates/)

senses.ms_definition: Yang telah kehilangan kuasa, kedudukan atau nama baik; dalam konteks keagamaan, yang telah jatuh daripada keadaan suci.
senses.nuances: 属于英语比喻用法。宗教意义须依具体传统解释；历史表达 fallen woman 带有对女性的贬抑和道德评判，不宜用于现代中性称呼。[Cambridge: fallen](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/fallen)

etymology.historical_story: Fallen belongs to the English family of fall, whose history reaches back to Old English feallan. Its ending reflects English participle formation, not Malay affixation. The physical image of something coming down also supports figurative uses involving lost power or status. In memorial language, the fallen refers to people killed in war. Its occurrence in a Malay corpus alone does not establish it as a Malay loanword. [Merriam-Webster: fall](https://scrabble.m-w.com/dictionary/fall)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fall → fell → fallen 连成三个画面：往下落、落下了、已经落下。记牢 fallen 的 -en 属于英语，不是马来语词缀。

morphology.formula: ∅ + fighting → fighting（按资料包作为外语整词处理）
morphology.pattern_note: 资料包的词根字段按原样保留；英语内部结构为 fight + -ing → fighting，-ing 不是马来语词缀。英语读作两个音节，末尾为 /ŋ/。韩语助威表达有不同的语音形式，不应与本条英语 IPA 混同。

senses.zh_definition: 打斗、交战或战斗活动。
senses.en_definition: Physical combat or the activity of engaging in battle.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan bergaduh, bertempur atau berperang, khususnya pertempuran antara pihak yang bermusuhan.
senses.nuances: 英语中通常作不可数名词。马来语须依规模选用 pergaduhan、pertempuran 或 peperangan。资料包未提供 DBP 释义，本条马来文为英语义项的解释性译写。[Cambridge: fighting](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/fighting)

senses.zh_definition: 英语 fight 的现在分词或动名词形式，表示打斗、作战、对抗或奋力争取。
senses.en_definition: Present participle or gerund of fight: engaging in combat, resisting, or striving for something.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk -ing bagi kata kerja Inggeris fight, yang bermaksud bergaduh, bertempur, menentang atau berjuang mengikut konteks.
senses.nuances: 此处标示英语动词形式；英语进行时通常需要 be。fighting for 表示为某事争取，fighting against 表示对抗某事。不能在标准马来语中把 -ing 当作表达进行体的本族词缀。[Cambridge: fight](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/fight)

collocations.ms: berjuang demi keadilan (Inggeris: fighting for justice)

senses.zh_definition: 用于战斗的；或表现出顽强斗志的。
senses.en_definition: Used for combat, or showing determination and readiness to struggle.
senses.ms_definition: Yang digunakan untuk pertempuran, atau yang menunjukkan semangat juang dan keazaman.
senses.nuances: 属于英语定语用法。fighting spirit 指斗志，不必涉及暴力；fighting forces 则指军事力量。马来语对应表达通常改变词组结构，而不是逐词照译。[Collins: fighting](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/fighting)

senses.zh_definition: 加油！用于鼓励对方努力、坚持或在比赛中取得好表现。
senses.en_definition: An informal cheer meaning “You can do it!” or “Go for it!”, associated with Korean usage.
senses.ms_definition: Seruan tidak rasmi untuk memberikan semangat, seerti dengan “Teruskan usaha!” atau “Anda boleh!”, yang dikaitkan dengan penggunaan bahasa Korea.
senses.nuances: 功能上是感叹性助威语；particle 是本模式允许的近似分类。韩语 파이팅 借自英语 fighting，并发展出助威功能。此义可出现在熟悉韩流的交流中，但不是普通英语 fighting 的通用感叹义，也不能据此认定为标准马来语词。[韩国国立国语院：파이팅](https://krdict.korean.go.kr/kor/dicMarinerSearch/search?mainSearchWord=%ED%8C%8C%EC%9D%B4%ED%8C%85&nation=kor&nationCode=6)

etymology.historical_story: Fighting is formed within English from fight and -ing. Its literal combat meaning must be distinguished from a later cross-language use: Korean 파이팅 functions as a cheer. Korea’s National Institute of Korean Language records that encouragement function, and Korean cultural material explains it through expressions such as “Go for it!” This distinction helps readers interpret friendly messages without confusing encouragement with an invitation to physical conflict. [Korea.net](https://www.korea.net/Events/Overseas/view?articleId=20979)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先看场景：战场上的 fighting 是“交战”，朋友面试前发的 Fighting! 是“加油”。同样的字母，靠语境切换画面。

morphology.formula: ∅ + French → French（英语整词；马来语对应 Perancis）
morphology.pattern_note: 保留输入的小写索引 french；表示法语、法国人或法国相关事物的英语标准拼写为 French。它不是已由所给材料确认的马来语官方词头，因此不标为 official。IPA 为英语读音；不虚构 Jawi 或马来语派生词族。以下收录其常见英语义项及马来语对应表达。

senses.zh_definition: 法语；英语 French 的语言名称义，标准马来语为 bahasa Perancis。
senses.en_definition: The French language, used in France and various other countries and communities.
senses.ms_definition: Bahasa Perancis; dalam pertuturan bercampur bahasa, nama Inggeris French kadangkala digunakan untuk merujuk bahasa ini.
senses.nuances: 此处解释英语词在马来语混语中的用法，不冒称为 DBP 的独立马来语词头释义。下列 ms 搭配为混语，正式对应为 kelas bahasa Perancis 和 belajar bahasa Perancis。参见 [Oxford：French，名词](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/french_2)及 [DBP：language 的英马对应](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=Bahasa)。

senses.zh_definition: 法国的、法国人的或法语的；用于英语短语，也可见于马来西亚菜单和混语表达。
senses.en_definition: Relating to France, its people, or their language.
senses.ms_definition: Berkaitan dengan negara Perancis, rakyatnya atau bahasa Perancis; makna kata sifat Inggeris French.
senses.nuances: 下列 ms 字段保留马来西亚菜单中可见的英语固定名称：French toast 可译 roti bakar Perancis，French fries 通常译 kentang goreng。固定菜名不能用来证明菜肴起源于法国。形容词义参见 [American Heritage：French](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=FRENCH)。

collocations.zh: 法式吐司；浸蛋液后煎制的面包

senses.zh_definition: 法国人这一群体；英语通常用 the French，标准马来语按语境用 orang Perancis 或 rakyat Perancis。
senses.en_definition: The people of France collectively, normally expressed as the French.
senses.ms_definition: Orang Perancis secara kolektif; dalam bahasa Inggeris lazimnya disebut the French.
senses.nuances: 这是英语集合名词用法；英语中通常不以 a French 指“一个法国人”。下列 ms 字段使用标准马来语对应表达，不把英语集合名词误作马来语词法。参见 [Oxford：French，集合名词义](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/french_2)。

etymology.historical_story: English French descends from Old English Frencisc, historically connected with the Franks. Its presence in a Malay conversation is a separate matter: speakers may insert the English label when discussing language classes or familiar menu items. Standard Malay uses Perancis for the corresponding national reference and bahasa Perancis for the language. English ancestry does not establish official Malay headword status. [American Heritage](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=FRENCH), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=Bahasa)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 建立三语对照链：French ↔ Perancis ↔ 法国；说“法语”时，马来语补上 bahasa：bahasa Perancis。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语来源的整词形式；所列 IPA 为英语读音。不能把英语词典中的全部义项自动视为马来语义项；也不据此生造马来语派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 翻转；使物体或图像转到另一面或呈相反方向。这里作为英语动词嵌入马来语口语使用。
senses.en_definition: To turn something over or reverse its orientation, used as an English insertion in Malay conversation.
senses.ms_definition: Membalikkan atau menterbalikkan sesuatu; penggunaan kata kerja Inggeris dalam pertuturan bercampur bahasa.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词语切换用法，不是据本次证据核定的独立马来语标准动词。正式表达按动作选用 membalikkan、menterbalikkan 或 menyelak。PRPM 的英语 flip 条目列有这些马来语对应表达。下列组合是口语教学示例，未经频率统计验证。[DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=flip)。

senses.zh_definition: 翻盖式结构；在 fon flip 一词中指具有翻盖结构的手机类型。
senses.en_definition: A hinged, flip-open design, used attributively in the Malay term fon flip.
senses.ms_definition: Reka bentuk berengsel yang boleh dibuka dan ditutup, khususnya dalam istilah fon flip.
senses.nuances: 本义按术语 fon flip 的名词修饰成分处理。DBP 曾建议以 fon flip 对应 flip phone；这项术语证据不等于所有英语 flip 义项均已成为马来语标准用法。[DBP 术语答复，2026 年 2 月 2 日](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=flip)。

etymology.historical_story: English flip has long described quick movements such as flicking and turning something over. Its historical origin is uncertain, with dictionaries connecting it to fillip or imitative movement words. In Malaysian usage, its borrowing must be assessed by context: DBP documents fon flip, while a conversational command such as flip gambar retains an English verb. [Oxford 词源说明](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/flip_3)、[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=flip)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到短促的 flip，就想象图片啪地翻过去；正式马来语按语境换成 membalikkan 或 menterbalikkan。

morphology.pattern_note: 此处按英语完整词形处理，不作马来语词缀拆分；IPA 为英式英语读音。未核实马来语派生词族，故不填造词。

senses.zh_definition: 运气；偶然影响事情结果的好运或坏运。

senses.ms_definition: Nasib baik atau buruk yang mempengaruhi apa yang berlaku kepada seseorang.
senses.nuances: 这里解释英语词义；PRPM 将 fortune 列于《Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan》，不能据此视为马来语普通词条已获确认。正式马来语通常用 nasib、nasib baik 或 tuah。以下搭配保留英语原文，ms_definition 为马来语释义性转述。[PRPM 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=nasib-nasibnya)

senses.ms_definition: Untung nasib seseorang atau perubahan keadaan yang dialami oleh seseorang, kumpulan atau perusahaan.
senses.nuances: 侧重人生遭遇或发展走势；英语 fortunes 常用于盛衰变化。tell someone's fortune 指预测命运，不是陈述已经发生的事实。马来语可按语境译为 untung nasib、nasib 或 perkembangan keadaan。[PRPM 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=nasib-nasibnya)

etymology.historical_story: English fortune came through Middle English and Old French from Latin fortuna. Its modern meanings connect luck, destiny and wealth: it can describe what happens to someone or the riches someone possesses. These English meanings explain the translation choices nasib and kekayaan; they do not establish fortune as a standard Malay borrowing. [American Heritage Dictionary](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=fortune)

etymology.historical_story: Fokus belongs to an international vocabulary whose ultimate Latin ancestor, focus, meant hearth or fireplace. Scientific usage developed the idea of a focal point, followed by figurative concentration. Malay uses fokus for both physical convergence and attention; adding -kan makes the instruction actionable: bring something into focus. See [OED](https://doi.org/10.1093/OED/2411416887) and [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=fokus).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: fokus联想英语focus；加-kan就像转动对焦环：把光线或注意力集中起来。

etymology.historical_story: The likely reference is a fictional invention, rather than an inherited Malay word. FLDSMDFR abbreviates Flint Lockwood Diatonic Super Mutating Dynamic Food Replicator, the food-making machine associated with Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs. This explains the unusual consonant sequence, but the packet alone cannot establish that its lowercase token names that machine. [Reference](https://scifi.stackexchange.com/questions/13823/what-powers-the-fldsmdfr-when-its-in-the-sky)
