etymology.historical_story: English family ultimately comes from Latin familia, a word covering a household and its dependants, including servants. Its history therefore reaches beyond the modern image of parents and children. English later developed familiar household and kinship meanings. In Malay conversation, using family inserts that English word; the standard Malay equivalent remains keluarga. [Source: Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/family).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听见 family，就想到“全家一起”；写规范马来语时，把这个英语词换成 keluarga。

etymology.historical_story: English forms fucker from the taboo verb fuck and the person-forming suffix -er. Its common insulting use does not normally describe sexual activity: it expresses hostility toward a person. Its appearance inside a Malay conversation can reflect code-switching, but that occurrence alone does not establish it as an official Malay dictionary word. [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/fucker), [Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/fucker)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 英语 fuck 加表示人的 -er；实际听到辱骂时，通常理解为强烈的“混蛋”。记住“英语粗口”这一标签，避免把它当普通称呼。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语单音节词，在马来西亚夹杂英语的口语中常整体使用。末尾 ll 表示一个 /l/，不是两个音节；当地口音也可能实现为 [ful]。以下词族属于英语，不是马来语派生形式。

etymology.historical_story: English full descends from Old English full, which already expressed both filled capacity and completeness. Its use within Malay conversation brings an English word into Malay sentence patterns. For learners, the useful cultural lesson is contextual translation: a full hotel is penuh, a full version is lengkap, and a full diner is kenyang. See [full: word history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/full).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象容量条升到 FULL：酒店满房是 penuh，内容全齐是 lengkap，人吃饱是 kenyang。同一个 full，按对象选马来语词。

etymology.historical_story: Forbes takes its name from its founder, B. C. Forbes, who established the magazine in 1917. Its first issue appeared on September 15 that year. What began as a family surname became the title of a business publication and later an international media brand. Malay references retain the name rather than translating its components. [Forbes history](https://tollbit.forbes.com/connect/editorial/)

etymology.historical_story: Malay computing terminology pairs English font with fon, giving the short spelling an established role in printing and digital documents. DBP also records fon in audio compounds such as fon telinga. Meanwhile, informal messages use the same spelling for telefon. These overlapping forms illustrate why context matters more than spelling alone when identifying a word's meaning. [DBP computing terminology](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/komputer1.pdf); [DBP dictionary](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=fon); [DBP messaging guidance](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/khidmatsms.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看屏幕上的字，fon 是 font；看到 kepala 或 telinga，想到耳机；聊天里“fon 我”，才是给我打电话。

etymology.historical_story: Latin anatomical vocabulary includes fel, with the genitive fellis, meaning gall or bile. An Indonesian anatomy terminology list pairs fel with empedu, illustrating the meeting of international anatomical terminology and local vocabulary. This correspondence does not establish the precise borrowing route into Indonesian. For Malaysian Malay learners, the useful connection is fel → hempedu; the Malaysian dictionary entry to learn for ordinary use is hempedu. Sources: [Lewis and Short](https://www.alatius.com/ls/index.php?met=up&ord=felare), [Indonesian anatomy terminology](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/2466/1/Daftar%20Istilah%20Anatomi%20%20103.pdf), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=308488&keyword=hempedu+).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: fel 读作 /fel/，一拍记住；看到 fel，就把它连到“胆汁 hempedu”。这是词义联想，不是词根拆解。

etymology.historical_story: The French word front comes from Latin frons, meaning forehead or face, an image that connects naturally with a forward surface. In Malaysian conversation, English expressions such as front desk can appear within Malay sentences. That conversational use must be distinguished from dictionary recognition: the verified PRPM headword here belongs to its English dictionary. [Académie française](https://www.dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A9F1761); [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=front)

etymology.historical_story: The Fifield surname study connects the name with English settlements named for holdings of five hides. A hide was a historical land assessment associated with supporting a household, rather than a universally fixed area. Place names could subsequently become surnames. This background explains an English naming tradition; it does not make Fifield a Malay word. [Fifield One-Name Study](https://fifield.one-name.net/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 首字母大写Fifield，先想到人名或地名；把它作为完整名字记住，不拆成马来语词根。

senses.zh_definition: 幻想的；虚构而非现实的，尤指具有超现实想象内容的事物。
senses.en_definition: Existing in or characterized by fantasy rather than reality.
senses.ms_definition: Bersifat fantasi atau khayalan dan tidak berasaskan kenyataan.
senses.nuances: 这是印度尼西亚语 fantastis 的释义，马来语释义为说明性转述。马来西亚正式写作通常用 fantastik。status 沿用指定标签，不表示 fantastis 已获 DBP 马来西亚规范拼写认证。参见 [Cambridge 印度尼西亚语词条](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/indonesian-english/fantastis) 与 [DBP fantastik 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=fantastik)。

senses.zh_definition: 不可思议的；离谱得令人难以置信的，常形容价格、金额或规模异常之大。
senses.en_definition: So extreme or improbable as to seem unbelievable.
senses.ms_definition: Terlalu luar biasa sehingga sukar dipercayai atau dianggap tidak munasabah.
senses.nuances: 可表达惊讶，也可带质疑，并非必然称赞。这里的搭配展示印度尼西亚语用法；马来西亚语境宜按意思改用 luar biasa、sukar dipercayai 或 tidak munasabah。义项参见 [印度尼西亚语词典释义汇录](https://id.wiktionary.org/wiki/fantastis)。

senses.zh_definition: 极其出色的；非常精彩、令人赞叹的。
senses.en_definition: Exceptionally good, impressive, or wonderful.
senses.ms_definition: Sangat hebat, cemerlang atau mengagumkan.
senses.nuances: 印度尼西亚语中的强烈赞语；马来西亚通常使用 fantastik、hebat 或 mengagumkan。须由上下文判断是赞赏还是对夸张程度的惊讶。印度尼西亚语义项参见 [fantastis 释义](https://id.wiktionary.org/wiki/fantastis)，马来西亚对应义参见 [DBP fantastik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=fantastik)。

etymology.historical_story: Indonesian fantastis was borrowed from Dutch fantastisch. Its history helps explain why it resembles Malaysian Malay fantastik yet has a different ending: related international vocabulary entered neighbouring languages through different linguistic channels. The imaginative sense and the enthusiastic sense coexist, allowing the word to describe either an unreal world or a remarkably impressive performance. [Dutch loanword study](https://pure.knaw.nl/ws/portalfiles/portal/458170/Nww_compleet_archief.pdf).

senses.zh_definition: 森林：大片以树木及其伴生植被为主的土地。
senses.en_definition: A large area of land covered mainly with trees and associated vegetation.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bahasa Inggeris yang bermaksud hutan, iaitu kawasan luas yang ditumbuhi pokok-pokok dan tumbuhan lain.
senses.nuances: 普通马来语对应词是 hutan。以下搭配提供英语搭配的自然马来语对应形式。来源：[PRPM：forest](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=forest)。

senses.zh_definition: 林立的一大片事物，尤指密集竖立、形似森林的物体。
senses.en_definition: A dense collection of things resembling a forest, especially upright objects.
senses.ms_definition: Sekumpulan benda yang banyak dan rapat, khususnya benda yang tegak sehingga menyerupai hutan.
senses.nuances: 英语比喻用法，不必逐字译为 hutan。可使用 berceracak、berceranggah 或其他自然描述。来源：[PRPM：forest](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=forest)。

senses.zh_definition: 英国历史上供君主保育、狩猎野生动物的特定区域。
senses.en_definition: A historical English royal domain reserved for the protection and hunting of game.
senses.ms_definition: Kawasan diraja di England pada zaman dahulu yang dikhaskan untuk perlindungan dan pemburuan binatang buruan.
senses.nuances: 属于英语历史义，不能直接等同于马来西亚现代行政术语 hutan simpan。来源：[Merriam-Webster：forest](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/forest)。

senses.zh_definition: 使土地覆盖树木或形成森林。
senses.en_definition: To cover land with trees or establish forest on it.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan sesuatu kawasan diliputi pokok-pokok atau hutan.
senses.nuances: 这是英语及物动词用法，频率低于名词用法。马来语应按过程译为 menanam pokok 或 menghutan，而非把 forest 当作马来语动词。来源：[Merriam-Webster：forest](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/forest)。

etymology.historical_story: English forest came through French from a Latin expression associated with woodland outside an enclosure. In medieval England, a forest also had a royal hunting function, giving the word a historical meaning beyond an ordinary collection of trees. Modern English usually foregrounds tree cover, while standard Malay normally expresses that everyday meaning with hutan. [Source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/forest).

senses.nuances: 规范行文写作 Faris，属于专有名词；马来西亚大学的公开人员名录可证实其人名用法。阿拉伯语来源词 fāris 意为“骑手、骑士”，但称呼名叫 Faris 的人时不应把名字翻译成其职业。本释义为编辑撰写，不是 DBP 官方释义。输入未提供 Jawi，故保留 null；来源词的阿拉伯字形为 فارس。[UPM：Faris 人名实例](https://profile.upm.edu.my/faris.nasir/article.html)、[Hans Wehr：Arabic Dictionary](https://kutub.nur.nu/Arabic-Language/Hans-Wehr.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: The Arabic word fāris means a horseman or knight. Faris carries that word into personal naming, including Malaysian usage documented in university staff directories. A useful cultural distinction follows: a Malaysian named Faris is being identified by his name, not described as a cavalryman. The original image belongs to the name's history, not its everyday grammatical meaning. [Hans Wehr: Arabic Dictionary](https://kutub.nur.nu/Arabic-Language/Hans-Wehr.pdf), [UPM: personal-name usage](https://profile.upm.edu.my/faris.nasir/article.html)

senses.ms_definition: Memperlihatkan keadaan seseorang yang termenung atau sedang memikirkan perkara lain, khususnya melalui pandangan atau air mukanya.
senses.nuances: 这是英语的比喻义，常修饰 look 或 expression；并非指视力能看得远，也不能据此判断心理健康状况。下列 ms 项是自然的马来语对应表达，并非 faraway 的马来语搭配。参见 [Oxford Learner's Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/faraway)。

etymology.historical_story: English faraway combines far and away; Dictionary.com dates its first recorded use to 1810–1820. Its meanings connect physical distance with mental distance: a place can be remote, while an expression can suggest that someone's thoughts have wandered elsewhere. This is an English word history, rather than evidence of adoption into standard Malay. See [Dictionary.com](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/faraway).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: far 是“远”，away 是“离开”：地点离得远，就是“遥远的”；心思飘远了，目光就显得“恍惚”。马来语分别联系 jauh 和 termenung。

etymology.historical_story: Francine belongs to a French naming tradition associated with Françoise and Francis. Nominis connects it with the Latin name of the Franks. In a Malay sentence, however, the name identifies a person rather than translating that historical association into a description of her nationality, character, or identity. See [Nominis](https://nominis.cef.fr/contenus/prenom/727/Francine.html).

morphology.pattern_note: 作为借入的单位名称整词记忆，不拆出马来语词缀。所列 IPA 为英语来源读音；输入没有提供核定的马来语音标、音节或爪夷文。

senses.zh_definition: 法拉第；电量的非国际单位制单位，等于一摩尔电子所带电荷量的绝对值，约为 96485 库仑。
senses.en_definition: A non-SI unit of electric charge equal to the magnitude of the charge of one mole of electrons, approximately 96,485 coulombs.
senses.ms_definition: Cas elektrik yang diperlukan untuk membebaskan 1 gram-setara suatu bahan melalui proses elektrolisis.
senses.nuances: 这是小写单位名 faraday。马来语释义引自 [DBP PRPM 物理术语资料](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=setara+1)。它与单位为 C/mol 的法拉第常数有关，但二者量纲不同；也不要与电容单位 farad 混淆。摩尔电荷概念参见 [IUPAC Faraday constant](https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/F02325)。以下为专业语境中的自然数量组合，不表示日常高频搭配。

senses.zh_definition: 法拉第；姓氏，在科学语境中常指英国科学家迈克尔·法拉第，也见于以他命名的定律和装置。
senses.en_definition: The surname Faraday, especially that of Michael Faraday, appearing in scientific eponyms.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga, khususnya nama Michael Faraday, yang digunakan dalam penamaan hukum dan peralatan sains.
senses.nuances: 此义正文须写作 Faraday，属于专有名词；本项马来语释义为编辑说明。不要把 hukum Faraday 中的姓氏理解成电量单位。人物及其研究见 [英国皇家研究院人物资料](https://www.rigb.org/explore-science/explore/person/michael-faraday-1791-1867)。

etymology.historical_story: The unit carries the surname of Michael Faraday, whose experiments helped connect electricity, magnetism, and chemical change. His discoveries included electromagnetic induction in 1831 and the laws of electrolysis in the early 1830s. That scientific legacy explains why his name appears both in electrochemical terminology and in classroom discussions of generators. See [the Royal Institution](https://www.rigb.org/explore-science/explore/person/michael-faraday-1791-1867).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 faraday 和“法拉第的电解实验”连起来：这里数的是电荷；farad 则数电容。

etymology.historical_story: English foreman combines fore, suggesting the front or leading position, with man. The image is of someone at the head of a working group. The word also names a jury's leader and spokesperson. In Malay, DBP distinguishes the occupational equivalents mandur and formen from the legal equivalent ketua juri.

etymology.historical_story: The two meanings of filem preserve a technological connection: physical photographic material and the moving pictures recorded on it. Malay cinema also carries a regional history. Malaysia's National Archives identifies Laila Majnun, produced in 1933, as an early landmark. Adding -nya links either the material or the finished work to an established referent. [National Archives of Malaysia](https://ofa.arkib.gov.my/ofa/group/asset/1039552).

etymology.historical_story: The Dictionary of American Family Names records Fineman as an Americanized form of the Ashkenazic Jewish surnames Feinmann or Feinman. This documents one naming history, not the ancestry of every present bearer. In Malay writing, Fineman normally remains an unchanged surname, and the packet supplies no evidence linking it to a specific individual.

etymology.historical_story: Fuji carries two familiar Japanese associations into Malay: a mountain and an apple. Japan's agricultural research organisation records that the apple was registered in 1962 and named with reference to both Fujisaki, where it was developed, and Mount Fuji. Thus the supermarket name connects a breeding location with a celebrated national landmark. [NARO](https://www.naro.go.jp/laboratory/nifts/kih/apple_cat/post_13.html)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Fuji 联想中文“富士”：Gunung Fuji 是富士山，epal Fuji 是富士苹果；前面的名词决定指什么。

etymology.historical_story: Frye enters this entry as a surname, rather than an inherited Malay vocabulary item. One documented bearer, Northrop Frye, studied at Victoria College in Toronto and later joined its English department. His academic career explains the surname's appearance in literary discussion. The packet does not establish a particular bearer or the surname's deeper historical origin. [Source: Victoria University Library](https://library.vicu.utoronto.ca/exhibitions/nfrye100/biography.html)

etymology.historical_story: English foster comes through Middle English from Old English forms associated with food and feeding. Its history connects nurturing a child with supporting growth more broadly. That connection helps explain why modern English uses the same word for caring for children, temporarily housing animals, and encouraging cooperation or creativity.

etymology.historical_story: Fergus belongs to the Irish and Scottish naming tradition. Its Old Irish elements are commonly interpreted as fer, meaning man, and guss, meaning vigour or strength. This historical explanation concerns a personal name, not a Malay vocabulary item. When the name appears in Malay writing, it retains its identity as a proper name. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/fergus).

etymology.historical_story: Fasilitas belongs to an international borrowing family associated with Dutch faciliteit and English facility. Indonesian terminology guidance illustrates the adaptation of endings such as -iteit and -ity to -itas. For Malaysian learners, the useful cultural distinction is between recognizing this Indonesian form and choosing kemudahan in Malaysian writing. [Indonesian terminology guidance](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/273/1/Pedoman_Umum%20Pembentukan_Istilah_PBN.pdf)

morphology.formula: ∅ + freaking → freaking（马来语混用中的英语整词）
morphology.pattern_note: 按输入包及马来语语码转换层面作为整词处理，不将 -ing 误认作马来语词缀。英语动词用法可分析为 freak + -ing；强调语的历史还涉及对粗俗强调词的委婉替代，不能只凭现代拼写推导。

word_family.gloss: 英语相关动词：情绪失控；使惊慌
freak 的过去式或过去分词

senses.zh_definition: 非常；简直；极其。用于加强程度或表达强烈情绪。
senses.en_definition: An informal intensifier expressing strong emphasis, excitement, or annoyance.
senses.ms_definition: Kata penguat bahasa Inggeris tidak formal yang menegaskan darjah atau emosi, seperti sangat atau betul-betul.
senses.nuances: 英语俚语，可出现在马来语与英语混用中；不是规范马来语程度副词。马来语释义为解释性翻译，并非 DBP 官方释文。以下保留常见英语搭配，以免把临时混用写成固定马来语搭配。参见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/freaking)。

senses.zh_definition: 置于名词前加强语气，常带烦躁、愤怒或惊讶；可按语境译为该死的、这破……。
senses.en_definition: Used before a noun to add strong emphasis, often conveying irritation.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bahasa Inggeris tidak formal yang hadir sebelum kata nama untuk menegaskan emosi, terutama rasa geram.
senses.nuances: 这是英语前置强调用法，不表示名词本身具有怪异属性。正面或负面色彩须看语境。以下为英语搭配，ms_definition 为马来语解释性翻译。参见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/freaking)。

senses.zh_definition: 作为英语 freak 的 -ing 形式，表示正在惊慌、情绪激动或失控，或使别人产生这种反应；常与 out 连用。
senses.en_definition: The -ing form of freak, meaning to become or make someone extremely emotional, often with out.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk -ing bagi kata kerja Inggeris freak, lazimnya bersama out, yang bermaksud menjadi atau menyebabkan seseorang sangat cemas atau teruja.
senses.nuances: I'm freaking out 描述情绪状态，不等于副词强调用法。This is freaking me out 表示这件事让我非常不安。马来语释义为解释性翻译。参见 [Cambridge Dictionary: freak out](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/freak-out)。

collocations.en: making me very uneasy or frightened

etymology.historical_story: English freaking developed an emphatic slang use as a milder substitute for stronger taboo expressions. Collins places this intensifier in the twentieth century, while American Heritage connects it with frigging. Its use inside Malay conversation is code-switching; it does not establish a separate Malay derivation or an officially standardized Malay equivalent. See [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/freaking) and [American Heritage](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=freaking).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到拉长的 FREEK，就想象情绪音量突然调大：freaking expensive＝贵得离谱；多一个 out，通常转成慌了或情绪失控。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中作为完整借词记忆；没有马来语词缀交替。词族中的 klaustro-、agora- 是国际术语组合成分。

senses.zh_definition: 对某种事物或情境产生的极度恐惧；恐惧症。
senses.en_definition: An extreme fear of a particular thing or situation; a phobia.
senses.ms_definition: Ketakutan yang amat sangat akan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 比一般的 takut（害怕）程度更强。日常谈话中也可夸张表示对某事十分畏惧，但这种说法本身不等于临床诊断。常用 fobia terhadap + 恐惧对象。马来语核心释义见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=250808&keyword=fobia)。

etymology.historical_story: Fobia belongs to an international vocabulary of fear whose ultimate source is Greek phobos, meaning fear or panic. Malay uses the adapted spelling fobia. Related terms such as klaustrofobia show how this vocabulary names particular fears. The precise route and date of the Malay borrowing are not established here. [Greek origin](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=-phobia).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把英语 phobia 的 ph 换成 f，就能认出 fobia：害怕到想躲开。

senses.zh_definition: 英语 find 的过去式及过去分词，表示找到、发现、查明或经判断认为。

senses.nuances: 这是英语形式，尚未核实为官方马来语词条。具体译法由 find 的语义及句法决定；was found 常译为 ditemukan 或 didapati。以下 ms 搭配为马来语对应表达，不是含 found 的马来语固定搭配；本条各义同样采用此原则。[Cambridge：found](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/found)

etymology.historical_story: English found brings together several histories. As the past form of find, it belongs to that verb's inflectional system. The verb meaning establish came through French from Latin fundare, associated with a base or foundation. The casting verb instead traces through French to Latin fundere, meaning pour. Identical spelling therefore conceals distinct origins. [Merriam-Webster word history](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/found)

etymology.historical_story: English fleet descends from Old English flēot, associated with ships and floating. Its collective meaning extended from vessels to aircraft and road vehicles. etymology.historical_story: Fredricksen is securely documented as the surname of Carl in Pixar's Up. Its spelling resembles northern European patronymic surnames, but resemblance alone cannot establish the history of this exact form or the ancestry of a particular bearer. etymology.historical_story: Fatima comes from the Arabic personal name Fāṭima, associated etymologically with weaning. Its cultural prominence is closely connected with Fatima, the daughter of the Prophet Muhammad. The name travelled across Muslim communities in several spelling forms. In Malay contexts, Fatimah is also familiar, but an individual's recorded spelling should always be preserved. [Source: Fatima, meaning and history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/fatima).

etymology.historical_story: Frasa belongs to the international grammatical vocabulary associated with Greek phrasis, meaning expression or speech. In Malay classrooms, it names a structural unit rather than simply a memorable saying. This distinction helps learners see how words group around a head, such as rumah in rumah besar, before those groups become parts of larger clauses.

etymology.historical_story: Faham entered Malay from Arabic fahm, meaning understanding. Its Arabic ancestry remains visible in the Jawi spelling فهم. Malay speakers incorporated the borrowed word into their own grammatical system, producing forms such as memahami and kefahaman. Adding the Malay interrogative particle -kah creates fahamkah, a compact question that combines an Arabic-derived vocabulary item with Malay question marking. [词源参考](https://ms.wiktionary.org/wiki/faham)

etymology.historical_story: Faraj is an Arabic loanword, identified as such in Kamus Dewan. Its established Malay dictionary meaning concerns female genital anatomy. etymology.historical_story: English far continues Old English forms associated with distance and remoteness. etymology.historical_story: Francesca belongs to the naming family of Francis and Francesco. Its historical ancestor, Latin Franciscus, referred to a French person. Over time, that descriptive origin became a personal name. The name's linguistic history therefore concerns how names develop, rather than describing the nationality or personality of someone called Francesca today. [Sources: Francesca](https://www.behindthename.com/name/francesca), [Francis](https://www.behindthename.com/name/francis)

word_family.gloss: 有羽毛的；装饰有羽毛的

senses.zh_definition: 羽毛；构成鸟类体表覆盖物的轻质结构，典型羽毛有中央羽轴及两侧羽枝。
senses.en_definition: One of the light structures covering a bird's body, typically having a central shaft with branching filaments.
senses.ms_definition: Perkataan bahasa Inggeris bagi bulu burung, lazimnya mempunyai batang tengah dengan cabang halus pada kedua-dua sisinya.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词义，不能据此标为 DBP 正式马来语词。马来语通常说 bulu 或为避免歧义说 bulu burung；bulu 还可指兽毛等。英语 feather 是可数名词，复数为 feathers。所列搭配为马来语对应表达，释义为自行编写。[英语释义](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/feather)、[DBP 的 bulu 条目](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=bulu)

senses.zh_definition: 划船时，在回桨阶段将桨叶转至接近水平的位置，以减少空气阻力。
senses.en_definition: To turn an oar blade nearly horizontal above the water during the recovery between strokes.
senses.ms_definition: Memusingkan bilah dayung supaya hampir mendatar di atas air ketika dayung dikembalikan untuk kayuhan seterusnya.
senses.nuances: 英语划船术语义；马来语可按动作解释，不应把它机械翻译成 bulu。以下搭配为马来语动作说明，并非已核定的单词对译或高频术语。[术语义依据](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/feather?topic=rowing)

collocations.zh: 以桨叶水平的姿态回桨
collocations.en: to recover with the oar feathered

etymology.historical_story: Feather descends from Old English feðer and belongs to an old Germanic word family that includes German Feder. It was inherited within English rather than formed with Malay affixes. The English verb also has an Old English ancestor meaning to furnish with feathers or wings, connecting the action with the noun. [Source](https://www.etymonline.com/word/feather)
